jobs.title: Curriculum & Education Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Applies knowledge of curriculum, program requirements, and educational activities to coordinate residency education programming and program\-wide curricular activities for the Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care. Coordinates and maintains program operations related to didactic scheduling, faculty development activities, and major educational events, including the Anesthesia Education Day (AED) series, graduation, and annual class retreats.


Maintains a program\-wide view of resident educational activities and curriculum scheduling to identify sequencing, timing, and scheduling considerations and provide guidance to program leadership. Serves as the primary scheduling contact for the PRIMER CA\-1 curriculum each summer, coordinating educational activities and schedules across participating faculty, residents, and program stakeholders.


**Department Overview**

The Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care ranks as one of the largest departments in the School of Medicine, with an annual budget of $207 million. The three largest components of the annual revenue budget are Funds Flow Revenue, the affiliation agreement with the city and county of San Francisco, and Extramural Funds, which together represent 85\.2% or $171 million. As of 2026, the department has over 200 Faculty members, 27 Staff Physicians, 200 Staff Employees, 6 Fellows, 90 Residents, 17 Non\-Faculty Academics, 13 Post Docs, and 8 Nurse Practitioners. The department also works closely with 68 Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetists (CRNAs).


In addition to the Moffitt\-Long Hospital, very active units of the department exist at the Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital (ZSFG) (inpatient and outpatient, including an active trauma service); San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center (inpatient and outpatient); Mount Zion Medical Center (outpatient, including 23 hour stays); Benioff Children's Hospital Oakland; the UCSF Orthopedic Institute; the Benioff Children's, Betty Irene Moore Women's and Bakar Cancer (NIH\-designated Cancer Center) Hospitals; and the Bayfront Medical Building (outpatient, Center for Pain Medicine) in the Mission Bay neighborhood.


The Department now has essential roles in patient care outside of the operating rooms, with active participation in Ambulatory Care, Acute and Chronic Pain, and in the Preoperative Clinic. Since 1958, the department has been at the heart of modern anesthesia’s explosive growth, and to this day continues to have an enormous impact on surgical practice and the management of pain. The department’s research, education, and clinical care earned and have maintained reputations equal to or better than that of any institution in the world. Individual members of our faculty have had a major influence on our specialty both nationally and internationally, including NIH study sections, NIH funding, and FDA and Editorial Boards. Research activities within the department are integrated with and inform clinical practice. For many years, ours has been among the top departments in the United States for NIH research funding in anesthesia.


  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
* A minimum of three (3\) years of related experience.
* Thorough knowledge of relevant policies and regulatory requirements. Solid knowledge of graduate medical education/residency program requirements. Thorough knowledge of the medical education industry.
* Thorough knowledge of curriculum development and instructional design principles; demonstrated ability to evaluate curriculum content and advise on sequencing and timing across a multi\-year training program.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing large\-scale educational events (e.g., retreats, graduation, conferences, career/job fairs), including space reservations, logistics, and vendor/speaker coordination.
* Demonstrated experience and documented excellence in oral and written communications skills; ability to work effectively and diplomatically with faculty, program leadership, and residents.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-management skills; ability to support and monitor advising/mentoring relationships and hold stakeholders accountable to program goals.
* Excellent organizational skills, analytical ability, and demonstrated attention to detail; ability to manage multiple concurrent scheduling and logistics projects and meet competing deadlines.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in related area.
* Experience with, or demonstrated ability to quickly learn, scheduling and educational program software and platforms.

This position is onsite five days per week.

* Unlock all campus bikes in the morning and secure them at the end of the day.
* Recover campus bikes from offsite locations as needed.
* Assist with bike upkeep, including cleaning, replacing bike number decals, and identifying bikes that require servicing.
* Support the loaner bike program, including bike sizing, helmet fitting, and rider education.
* Assist with bike\-related events and classes, including Bike to Work Day, demo events, and educational sessions.

* Valid driver's license required.
* Ability to lift up to 40 lbs.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values of respect, integrity, service, and excellence. We value diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences and provide opportunities for professional growth and development.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, People Experience
jobs.description:
Zoox is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to join our People Experience (PEx) team, serving as PEx PMO's strategic partner to our Talent Acquisition organization. This role owns the planning, reporting, and vendor infrastructure that lets Talent hire efficiently and confidently at scale — from hiring capacity models to executive reporting to our large\-scale industry conference presence. We're looking for someone with strong program management skills and real Talent Acquisition operations experience who can build the systems Talent leadership relies on to make good decisions. As PEx's needs evolve, this person will also be expected to take on new projects and departments beyond Talent.
### **Responsibilities**

* Program \& Project Leadership: Lead Talent Operations initiatives end\-to\-end — including the Referral Rewards Program, requisition administration, process improvement efforts, and tooling rollouts.
* Strategic Translation \& Execution: Own enterprise Hiring Goals capacity planning methodology, translating business growth targets into concrete hiring plans in partnership with Talent leadership and HRIS.
* Event \& Conference Operations: Own end\-to\-end planning and execution for large\-scale industry conferences (e.g., CVPR), including budget, vendor management, and operational logistics — plus lighter\-touch support for smaller industry events.  

Interviewing \& Enablement Support: Provide light\-touch support for interview standardization (playbooks, calibration) and Talent enablement initiatives (onboarding curriculum, SOPs) as needed.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Cross\-Functional Alignment: Serve as the primary point of contact between PEx PMO and the Talent organization, partnering closely with Recruiting leadership, HRIS, and Legal to ensure alignment across initiatives.  

Talent Tooling \& Vendor Management: Own relationships with core Talent tooling vendors (Lever, Gem, LinkedIn, ModernLoop, and others), partnering on tool roadmap decisions and budget/contract planning.
* Governance \& Reporting: Own executive\-facing reporting, including the Monthly Hiring Report, and partner with HRIS on data governance and quality for Talent's Workday\-based reporting infrastructure.

### **Initiative\-Based Responsibilities**

* Hiring Goals \& Capacity Planning: Build and maintain the methodology Zoox uses to plan hiring capacity against business growth targets — one of the most complex, least\-documented pieces of Talent's operating model today.
* AI in Talent: Partner with Legal/Employment Law on the responsible adoption of AI tools and processes within interviewing and recruiting — a high\-sensitivity, cross\-functional initiative requiring careful, thoughtful execution.

### **Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of relevant program management experience, with a focus on Talent Acquisition operations, recruiting program management, or workforce/hiring capacity planning.
* Proven experience designing and delivering scalable operational programs in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong functional expertise in recruiting/TA systems and tooling (e.g., Lever, Gem, LinkedIn Recruiter, or equivalent).
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills, with demonstrated experience building data\-driven planning models.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of influencing senior leaders and stakeholders.
* Experience partnering with Legal, Compliance, or similar functions on sensitive, high\-visibility initiatives.
* Strong group facilitation and presentation skills across a variety of formats.
* Experience planning and executing large\-scale conferences, corporate events, or offsites, including budget and vendor management.


If you are ready to adapt to new challenges, take on new roles as needed, and hit deadlines, we would love to hear from you. If you’re not shy about herding cats and managing chaos, then this role was made for you!
**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description:
**TELECARE CORPORATION**  

**Case Manager II \- Canyon Vista**



Telecare's mission is to deliver excellent and effective behavioral health services that engage individuals in recovering their health, hopes, and dreams. Telecare continues to advance cultural diversity, humility, equity, and inclusion at all levels of our organization by hiring mental health peers, BIPOC, LGBTQIA\+, veterans, and all belief systems.



Canyon Vista is a 57 unit transitional and permanent supportive housing (PSH) program serving adults in San Mateo County with serious mental illness. Telecare will provide onsite case management, housing stabilization and rehabilitative services to tenants living in transitional and PSH units. Services onsite will be available 24 hours a day, 7 days per week.

jobs.title: Shelter Case Manager (Full-Time)
jobs.description:
Covenant House California (CHC) is a nonprofit organization that provides sanctuary and support for youth overcoming homelessness, ages 18\-24\. CHC believes that no young person deserves to be homeless; that every young person in California deserves housing, food, clothing, education, and most importantly, to be loved. CHC provides a full continuum of services to meet the physical, emotional, educational, vocational, and spiritual well\-being of young people.


CHC’s doors are open to youth and staff regardless of their race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We believe that youth and team members deserve to be in an environment that is inclusive and affirming; where everyone is treated with dignity and respect and valued and appreciated for who they are. Maintaining a diverse community of youth and staff is key to our ability to achieve our mission most effectively. We are also committed to being a leader in advancing anti\-racism, and to promoting opportunities for the free expression of the lived experiences of our youth and staff.


We are looking for people who, like us, believe that every young person deserves a place to belong. We think it takes all kinds of people to create diverse solutions to end youth homelessness and we are on a committed journey to build an inclusive and equitable work culture that brings out the best in everyone. . In our Hayward location, you will be part of a growing system of care. Opened in April 2026, CHC offers the only shelter for youth in South Alameda County, and we are excited to continue to grow the services available to youth in the coming years in this community.


Covenant House California offers an excellent benefits package, (most benefits effective date of hire), including medical, vision, dental, an EAP program, 403b retirement account, and a generous vacation package.

**POSITION SUMMARY:** The Case Manager is responsible for working with youth to meet their housing, medical, mental health, employment and educational goals as they move towards becoming housed and having permanent connections. Essential functions of the position include intake and assessment, case planning, documentation, and basic individual and group counseling. The position is also responsible for providing these services within the framework of the Mission Statement, Five Principles, and the Policies and Procedures of Covenant House California.

**Classification**: Full\-time non exempt, 40 hours per week

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**


1\) Engage youth in developing their Individual Service Plan.


2\) Create an ISP for each youth that addresses areas all their critical needs, through a trauma\-informed and positive\-youth\-development model.


3\) Partner with the youth to create a clear structure of addressing their needs, complete with due dates, calendars, structure, guidance, and support.


4\) The case manager links clients to needed services, including making referrals, and as needed, facilitating the youth’s accessing of those services.


5\) Monitor client progress and aide youth in meeting their identified goals, and coaching youth to plan, implement, and follow\-through.


6\) Motivate clients to improve wellness along health, mental health, substance use/abuse/dependence, and other areas that will improve their overall functioning.


7\) Coordinate between other departments (clinical services, outreach, residential) and work as a team to meet client needs.


8\) Utilize innovative approaches to engaging youth in case management: such as conducting case management outside the building, on walks, in parks, and/or planning learning outing visits to the bank, grocery store, job\-site, etc.


9\) Partner with the youth to find full\-time employment. This work involves resume building, cover letter writing, job applications, interview preparedness, professionalism, etc.


10\) Partner with youth to identify and meet their educational goals, but not in lieu of employment which is the fastest track to self\-sufficiency and to becoming housed.


11\) For youth who have developmental, mental health, health, or social challenges, work with the youth to modify their case plan according, while at the same time balancing the responsibility to the youth to move them towards progress and becoming independent.


12\) Provide unconditional positive regard to clients regardless of behavior, race, class, culture, country of origin, disability, gender, gay, lesbian, trans, bi, language capacity, and ability to complete case plan requirements.


13\) Collaborate closely with team members to ensure that activities are focused on and in sync with the needs of youth.


14\) Maintain statistics and complete reports as needed.


15\) Attend weekly supervision with supervisor and all weekly meetings as assigned.


16\) All other duties as assigned

**JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

**EDUCATION:** Bachelor’s Degree in Psychology, Sociology, Social Work or a related field preferred, but will consider additional relevant experience.

**EXPERIENCE:** 2\-3 years of professional experience working with at\-risk/homeless youth, homeless services, child welfare or serving other at\-risk groups.

**SKILLS:** Prior Case Management Experience and an ability to build positive rapport with youth. Knowledge of the full range of public and social services in Alameda County and the Greater Bay Area for low\-income, homeless, and foster youth. Excellent communication skills, as demonstrated by on\-point, timely, and professional correspondence, both written and verbal inter\-agency coordination skills (scheduling appointments, and maintaining collaboration with multiple stakeholders and providers). Communication with and about youth must reflect a “strength based” and “trauma informed” approach. MUST be bilingual \- English/Spanish.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**  

  

The Senior Acquisition Operations Manager will be a key leader within Uber's **global** Acquisition Center of Excellence (CoE) in Delivery Commercial Operations (DCO), owning the **end\-to\-end design and evolution** of scalable acquisition processes across Uber's Delivery business.
  

  

This role operates at the **strategic intersection of process architecture, tooling strategy, and analytics** . The individual will define future\-state acquisition processes, set global standards, and use data and field insights to prioritize initiatives, inform investment decisions, and ensure acquisition health at scale.
  

  

The Acquisition CoE's work spans three major areas of scope:
* **Lead Management** (lead ingestion, qualification \& enrichment, AI\-based scoring, and allocation)
* **Opportunity Management** (pipeline creation standards, opportunity lifecycle governance, stage definitions, and pipeline quality)
* **Deal Management** (pricing workflows, approvals, discounting governance, and deal execution standards)

This role will own one or more of these domains and ensure tight integration across the end\-to\-end acquisition lifecycle.
  

  

**What the Candidate Will Do**  

  

**Future\-State Process Architecture \& Ownership*** Own the future\-state design for one or more acquisition domains (Lead, Opportunity, and/or Deal Management) within the end\-to\-end commercial lifecycle.
* Define global process standards, principles, and guardrails while enabling regional flexibility.
* Ensure strong integration, handoffs, and data continuity across acquisition stages.

**Tooling Strategy \& Business Requirements Leadership*** Lead the definition of complex business requirements and process intent for acquisition\-related tooling investments, including Salesforce and supporting systems.
* Partner closely with Product, Business Technology Engineering, and Digital Field Experience teams to shape solution design, prioritization, and sequencing.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs from design through implementation.

**Analytics\-Driven Prioritization \& Performance Management*** Use acquisition funnel, pipeline, and deal data to identify systemic issues and high\-impact opportunities.
* Define success metrics, KPIs, and monitoring frameworks to track acquisition health globally, including pipeline quality, velocity, and conversion.
* Partner with Insights teams to interpret trends, measure ROI, and inform continuous improvement.

**Global Stakeholder Leadership \& Change Enablement*** Act as a trusted partner to senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, Strategy, Enablement, and Regional teams.
* Lead global process discovery and alignment efforts across regions and segments.
* Shape and guide change management approaches, including rollout strategy, communications, and enablement.

**CoE Leadership \& Talent Development*** Set quality standards for process design, documentation, and requirements across the Acquisition CoE.
* Mentor and guide Acquisition Operations Managers and other CoE contributors.
* Contribute to building and evolving the Acquisition CoE operating model.

**Basic Qualifications*** 7\-10\+ years of experience in Commercial Operations, Revenue Operations, Process Architecture, or Strategy \& Operations
* Proven experience owning complex, cross\-functional, global process initiatives
* Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority
* Experience leading business requirements and partnering with Product and Engineering teams
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently interpret and leverage data for decision\-making
* Advanced proficiency with Salesforce and GTM tooling ecosystems

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience in marketplace, SaaS, or global sales organizations
* Familiarity with process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma)
* Experience leading large\-scale global process or tooling transformations
* SQL or advanced analytics experience a major plus
Excellent executive communication and storytelling skills  
* 

  

  

For New York City, NY\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year \- USD $180,000 per year.  

  

For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year \- USD $180,000 per year.  

  

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

jobs.title: Veterinary Technician Learning and Development Specialist
jobs.description:
**Veterinary Technician Learning \& Development Specialist**
============================================================


$40\.00–$50\.00/hour (DOE)  

Full\-Time \| SAGE Veterinary Centers


SAGE Veterinary Centers is seeking an experienced Veterinary Technician Learning \& Development Specialist (TLDS) to support the training, development, and clinical growth of our Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants.


This is a hands\-on clinical role for an experienced veterinary professional who enjoys both working on the hospital floor and developing others. The TLDS continues to work as a Veterinary Technician while helping assess clinical skills, train new team members, support onboarding, and build ongoing learning opportunities for the hospital team.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work hands\-on as a Veterinary Technician while serving as a clinical trainer and mentor for Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants.
* Assess clinical skills and provide direct, hands\-on training for new and existing team members.
* Facilitate Veterinary Assistant and Veterinary Technician training across multiple skill levels.
* Develop and deliver clinical in\-service training and educational sessions.
* Partner with Clinical Supervisors and hospital leadership to create individualized learning and development plans.
* Support onboarding and role\-specific training across hospital departments based on operational needs.
* Track completion of clinical training, competency assessments, protocols, and required learning modules.
* Assign and support training through VetBloom, Talent Unleashed, and other learning platforms.
* Help develop and standardize clinical protocols, practical assessments, and skill sign\-offs.
* Provide timely feedback to team members and leadership regarding training progress and development needs.
* Collaborate with the Ethos Clinical Learning \& Development team and other clinical trainers to implement updated training programs.
* Support continuing education programs, workshops, and hospital learning initiatives.
* Promote a positive learning environment focused on clinical excellence, professional development, and patient care.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Current Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT), Certified Veterinary Technician (CVT), Licensed Veterinary Technician (LVT), or equivalent credential required.
* Advanced veterinary clinical knowledge and strong hands\-on technical skills.
* Veterinary Technician Specialist (VTS) credential is a plus.
* Experience training, mentoring, precepting, or developing Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants.
* Ability to confidently perform and teach veterinary clinical skills, including patient assessment and triage, venipuncture, medication and fluid administration, CPR, and patient care.
* Strong presentation, coaching, and communication skills.
* Ability to provide constructive feedback and support employees at varying levels of clinical experience.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to track multiple training and development initiatives.
* Comfortable working independently and collaboratively with technicians, veterinarians, hospital leadership, and Learning \& Development partners.
* Ability to adapt training approaches to individual learning needs and changing hospital priorities.
* Experience with veterinary electronic medical record systems and learning management systems preferred.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule based on hospital training and clinical needs.

**Benefits**
------------


Eligible full\-time employees receive a comprehensive benefits package, which may include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with employer match
* Paid time off, including vacation and sick time

jobs.title: Administrative Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Involves managing or performing the administrative services or managing the full general operations of an academic or non\-academic organization(s). Administrative services include activities in finance and human resources and may also include IT, facilities, or student services. General management activities include long and short range strategic planning in determining the mission and directing all activities of multi\- disciplinary departments through subordinate management staff.


**Department Description:**

Alliance Health Project (AHP) is one of six clinical divisions, and several research programs that comprise Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and Trauma Center (ZSFG) Psychiatry, the second largest of 19 clinical departments at ZSFG. The mission of the AHP is to support the mental health and wellness of the lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and HIV\-affected communities in constructing healthy and meaningful lives. AHP is one of the oldest HIV organizations in the world and a leader in the field of HIV and mental health and behavioral health services focused on both HIV care and HIV prevention. AHP provides psychotherapy, substance use counseling, case management, support groups, psychiatry, sexual health services, clinical traineeship, and provider education and training. Our multi\-disciplinary staff are a client\-centered, collaborative, harm reduction\-oriented team. AHP has continued to grow as a community\-based clinic by anticipating and addressing the changing needs of our LGBTQ\+ and HIV community members for more than 40 years. Our process of continuous improvement of service to our community includes a strong focus on cultural humility and anti\-racist service provision.


AHP has an annual budget of $12 million from Federal, State and City contracts and grants, private foundations, individual donors, recharge operations, and an endowment, totaling over 40 projects; 60 full and part time staff, 5 clinical interns and over 100 volunteers per annum.


  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration or a public health field and 8\+ years of related work experience or a combination of comparable clinical education and/or experience. At least 5 years in a supervisory/lead/management role.
* Broad knowledge of the organization's processes, protocols and procedures with a focus on operations, human resources, personnel management under labor contract(s) and personnel policy.
* Ability to supervise an administrative and technical team to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* Strong knowledge of abstraction and collection of patient data, QI systems, external regulations, analytics and reporting
* Detail\-oriented, with the ability to apply analytical and critical thinking skills to quickly analyze problems, determine appropriate level of intervention, and apply effective solutions
* Demonstrated ability to effectively convey complex clinical and technical information both verbally and in writing, the ability to train and mentor direct reports, and to prepare and present various reports, documentation, analyses, and project proposals
* Working knowledge of business software and specialized applications and data management systems used in quality and performance improvement processes
* Broad knowledge of common organization\-specific and other computer application programs.
* Demonstrated management and conflict resolution skills to effectively lead and motivate others.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel, and database software, preferably Access.
* Experience with DEI principles and prior experience applying them in the work setting
* Excellent organizational, analytical and demonstrated project management abilities
* Strong working knowledge in contracts and grants
* Prior experience collaborating with DPH, DPH contracts, and relevant systems of care

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in business, healthcare administration, public health or related field.
* Prior work experience with HIV, LGBTQ\+, and BIPOC communities
* Prior UCSF, other UC campus experience or CCSF experience
* Knowledge of UCSF Government Business Contracts, Research Management Services

jobs.description:

**Position Summary**  

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.


The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Lead others and work effectively with store crews

Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement

Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints


Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.

Ability to work a full\-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise

Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

High school diploma or equivalent required

16**Time Type**


Part time**Pay Range**

**JOB SUMMARY:**
Overall Summary of Function
The Field Operations Manager oversees the day to day execution of field operations, including installation, strike, and on\-site production of events, ensuring all client work orders are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with Blueprint Studios’ quality standards. This role is responsible for managing Field Operations Supervisors, Leads, and installation crews while coordinating labor, logistics, and execution across multiple job sites.


The Field Operations Manager plays a critical role in planning, scheduling, and executing event installations and removals by aligning labor forecasting, trucking logistics, and operational timelines with internal teams including Sales, Production, Shipping, and Labor Coordination. This role ensures all projects are executed according to contract specifications, floorplans, and client expectations while maintaining strong cost control and operational efficiency.


In addition, this role provides leadership, training, and performance management for Field Operations teams, ensuring consistency in execution, safety compliance, and customer service. The Field Operations Manager promotes a culture of accountability, teamwork, and solution driven leadership while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

* Lead and manage Field Operations Supervisors, Leads, and field crews, ensuring all installations and strikes are executed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with company standards.
* Develop and coordinate labor plans, schedules, and staffing assignments in collaboration with the Labor Coordinator and internal teams.
* Provide ongoing coaching, training, and performance feedback to Field Operations team members to ensure consistency in execution and quality standards.
* Promote a culture of accountability, safety, teamwork, and high performance through consistent leadership and example.
* Enforce company policies, procedures, and discipline standards in a fair and consistent manner.

#### **Operational Execution \& Event Management**

* Oversee installation and strike operations across multiple job sites, ensuring all work is completed on time, within scope, and according to client specifications and floorplans.
* Conduct pre\-event site visits to assess conditions, confirm logistics, and ensure accurate planning for installations and strikes.
* Manage large scale, multi\-day events and travel shows, coordinating all aspects of on\-site execution.
* Ensure all event installations meet company quality standards and client expectations, including proper placement, finishing, and presentation.
* Coordinate external labor, vendors, and subcontractors as needed to support event execution.
* Coach and manage on\-site teams on proper product handling, loading, installation, strike, packing, and transportation procedures to minimize damages and protect company assets throughout all phases of event execution.
* Organize, complete, and manage all required production documentation, including production books and job\-related records.

#### **Cross Department Coordination**

* Collaborate closely with Sales, PMs, PCs, Production, Shipping, Receiving, Inventory, Fabrication, Floral, Print Shop, V\-Series, AV, and Labor teams to ensure alignment on schedules, logistics, operational priorities, and event execution plans.
* Coordinate trucking and logistics with Shipping and Receiving teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery of materials to job sites.
* Communicate accurate timelines, updates, and operational needs to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Serve as a key operational liaison between field teams and internal departments to resolve issues and maintain workflow continuity.

#### **Financial \& Operational Planning**

* Support labor forecasting, cost estimates, and budget management to ensure profitability of events and operational efficiency.
* Review and provide feedback on financial reports related to field operations, ensuring compliance with company reconciliation procedures.
* Monitor labor utilization and job performance to identify cost\-saving opportunities and improve operational efficiency.

#### **Safety, Compliance \& Quality Standards**

* Ensure all field operations activities comply with company safety policies, OSHA regulations, and best practices.
* Promote safe working conditions and enforce proper use of PPE, tools, and equipment across all job sites.
* Protect company assets, including equipment, materials, and inventory, during installations and strikes.
* Ensure all tools, equipment, and supplies are accounted for and returned after each event.

**Communication, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain clear and consistent communication with Operations, Sales, and leadership teams regarding project status, risks, and timelines.
* Provide real\-time updates from job sites and proactively address operational challenges.
* Identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend process improvements to enhance productivity and quality.
* Participate in production meetings, sales meetings, and operational reviews as required.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives that drive operational excellence and scalability.

#### **Additional Responsibilities**

* Identify operational inefficiencies, capability gaps, and areas for improvement across all warehouse departments.
* Drive improvement initiatives that reduce waste, lower costs, enhance quality, and strengthen workflow reliability.
* Use data, trends, and operational reports to make recommendations to senior leadership.
* Support implementation of lean principles, automation strategies, and best practices within warehouse operations.
* Performs other projects, administrative and operations duties as required

jobs.title: Clinic Operations Supervisor, Student Health Services (9359U), University Health Services - #89152
jobs.description:
Clinic Operations Supervisor, Student Health Services (9359U), University Health Services \- \#89152 About Berkeley
  
  

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  

Departmental Overview
  
  

UC Berkeleys University Health Services (UHS) is a comprehensive college health service providing fully accredited primary medical care, counseling and psychological services, and innovative health promotion programs for students, faculty, and staff. UHS provides on\-campus medical care and coordinates supplemental needs for off\-campus care through a network of community specialists and hospitals.
  
  

The Clinical Services Program within the UHS includes urgent care, primary care and specialty clinics, laboratory, pharmacy, physical therapy, radiology, and a major medical insurance plan. Approximately 65,000 visits occur annually including Primary Care, Urgent Care, Occupational Health and Specialty Clinics. Services are designed to enable students to get the most from their educational experience, minimizing the impact of illness, injury and emotional distress on their academic career.
  
  

Medical care and wellness programs are available to faculty and staff to meet their occupational health needs and minimize lost work time. These visits generate ancillary encounters with the Radiology, Clinical Laboratory, Physical Therapy and Pharmacy departments. The Counseling and Psychological Services department sees an additional 15,000 visits per year.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

The Clinic Operations Supervisor of Student Health Services, manages or performs the administrative services and/or clinical operations of assigned health care clinics in accordance with federal, local, and internal standards, policies, and regulations.
  
  

Application Review Date
  
  

**The First Review Date for this job is:** October 13, 2026\. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Clinical Patient Care \- 20%
  
  

Clinical work providing patient care as MA or LVN (within scope), more as needed per operational demand.
  
  

Hiring and Supervision \- 20%
  
  

Recruits, interviews and recommends hires of medical assistants.
  
Mentors, trains and orients medical assistants, medical assistant student trainees including performance management, cross training, skill building and career development.
  
Performs yearly performance evaluations on all career medical assistant staff.
  
Advise and ensure the policies and procedures to assure quality of care and customer service are followed by the incumbent's direct reports. Takes action for immediate improvements in performance as needed.
  
Collaborates with Clinical Services Management Team to ensure constant readiness for AAAHC accreditation.
  
Researches and resolves issues and discrepancies, including patient feedback and complaints.
  
  

Clinical Operational Support \- 40%
  
  

Maintains functional staffing levels.
  
Gives recommendations to improve or enhance performance of clinic support activities.
  
Actively participates in discussion of problem identification and resolution.
  
Reviews clinic templates and consults with clinic supervisors to manage inappropriate scheduling.

**Overview**
------------

  

Company Overview:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. Allied Universal® is hiring an Operations Manager. The Operations Manager is a central leader in ensuring successful delivery of security services across assigned client sites. This role oversees frontline hiring, staffing, scheduling, training, and operational compliance while serving as a critical support and escalation point for employees and clients. Selection and Placement* Manage the selection and placement process for new security professionals, including first\-line supervisors; design and implement career development and performance improvement plans; evaluate low\-performing employees for replacement, upgrade or transfer
* Make initial job offers (for new employees) and job transfers (for existing employees) using company forms and procedures, offering rates, schedules and benefits in alignment with post contract requirements; maintain and publish weekly Open Post List and actively manage job openings within division/branch


Schedule and Workforce Management* Create, modify and manage post schedules in WinTeam to ensure adequate coverage at all times; ensure schedules are properly maintained in WinTeam and are updated regularly

* Initiate termination procedures as needed for voluntary and involuntary separations; execute termination meetings as necessary and complete all follow up documentation according to company standards
* Maintain high employee morale and low employee turnover through effective and proactive communications and timely problem resolution; ensure all hiring, counseling, disciplinary and termination procedures are executed in a consistent manner

**QUALIFICATIONS (MUST HAVE):*** High School diploma or equivalent
* Current driver’s license if driving a company vehicle, or personal vehicle in the course of conducting business (e.g., client visits, attending networking events)

* Minimum of three (3\) years of leadership experience in a high\-volume workforce environment, preferably in the protective service industry
* Work experience in successfully building and developing teams
* Leadership skills that foster teamwork, innovation, agility, client relations and achieving desired results
* Ability to maintain a profitable book of business by cross\-collaborating and utilizing results\-oriented problem\-solving skills to meet both client and employee growth and satisfaction
* Proficiency in web\-based applications and computer systems, including Microsoft Office and (BI) Business Intelligence tools for metrics analysis, reporting, automation, and presentations
* Dynamic networking skills displaying a commitment to safety and trust by participating in local community, client and industry events
* Basic understanding of financial principles, including budgeting and financial reporting; ability to interpret simple financial data and use it to support decision\-making

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE TO HAVE):*** College degree in criminal justice, business administration

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Romig Engineers, Inc. has been in business for over 30 years and has grown to be a leading geotechnical and geologic engineering firm on the Peninsula for San Francisco Bay Area projects. Since its founding in 1994, the company has successfully completed over 7,000 projects, ranging from residential to high\-rise commercial and municipal developments. Our team of about 30 to 35 staff members includes licensed geotechnical engineers, civil engineers, geologists, field and laboratory technicians, and administrative staff collectively dedicated to delivering practical, cost\-effective solutions with exceptional service.

**Current Opportunity**

We are a growing firm and typically promote from within. At this time, we are looking externally for an engineer local to the area that will be a good fit for our team and is up for the challenge of being a Project Manager at Romig Engineers. An ideal candidate would be someone who has previous experience working on residential, municipal, and commercial projects in the Bay Area.

**Job Summary**

You will be joining our group of 6 engineering project managers, a licensed CEG, and three reviewing principal engineers. Three of the firm owners/experienced principals will be reviewing your work, and you will be working with most, if not all, members of the staff.

This position is structured to support an engineer moving from EIT to California PE registration, or preferably already a licensed Professional Engineer. This role offers a clear path to increasing project and client responsibility, and technical problem solving.

**Responsibilities**

The project manager position at Romig is a well\-rounded role that incorporates technical work, business development, internal leadership and mentoring, and a strong team centered approach. This role requires strong communication skills to work effectively with clients, design professionals, contractors, and Romig staff ranging from the firm’s principals to less experienced employees of the firm performing drilling and/or construction observation. The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to, the following:

o Interface with clients to understand the project and develop the project scope

o Prepare geotechnical proposals, reports, and plan reviews, and responding to agency review comments.

o Manage the project scope, schedule, and budget from authorization through delivery, which includes

* Managing the site subsurface investigation and laboratory testing programs
* Conducting site reconnaissance for projects with challenging site conditions and/or evaluating signs and causes of distress
* Supervision and logging of subsurface exploration for more complicated projects
* Performing geotechnical analyses and design of shallow and deep foundations, embankments and cuts, earth retaining systems, pavement, landslide repair, and geotechnical aspects of other site features for residential, commercial, and municipal projects
* Performing long\-term and seismic related settlement and slope stability analyses, and developing seismic design parameters

o Providing geotechnical support during design and construction phases, including value engineering with the design team for alternative cost\-effective solutions.

o Work with junior engineering and geology staff to develop and mentor their development

o Work with licensed geologists on projects that include a geologic component

o Work with principal engineers to develop technically and align with the firm’s strategy

o Develop new and maintain existing client relationships

**Ideal Candidate**

o California EIT registration with the ability to obtain CA PE, but preferably current CA PE registration

o 4\+ years of California progressively increasing geotechnical experience, including field and project management experience

o Knowledge of Bay Area practices and local geology; hillside and sloping\-site experience a plus

o B.S. or M.S. in Civil Engineering with geotechnical engineering emphasis

o Strong leadership and decision\-making skills

o Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills

o Self\-motivated with strong interest in career advancement

o Ability to work both independently and collaboratively

o Valid California driver's license

**Compensation Package**

o Competitive salary, range of salary depending on experience

o Quarterly bonus compensation program

o Medical, dental, vision, and long term disability

o 401(k) and Roth 401(k) retirement plan with matching contribution / profit sharing plan

o Paid holidays and PTO (include vacation and sick leave)

o Education allowance

o Professional association and license fee reimbursement

**Details**

Qualified individuals should email their resume and cover letter detailing their prior experience to info@romigengineers.com. For more information about our company, please visit www.romigengineers.com.

*Romig Engineers is an equal opportunity employer.*

Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  

  

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross\-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. Users come first at Google. jobs.title: Senior Environmental Designer / Project Manager, San Francisco
jobs.description:
**Who is Atelier Ten?**
  

Thank you for asking! Kindness and curiosity are some of Atelier Ten’s core tenets.


We are a team of environmental designers and carbon strategists championing for a healthier planet by leveraging our vast, collective knowledge of sustainable spaces. We help bring beauty and efficiency to every building, because like Maybelline, not all buildings are “born with it.” We work with architects, engineers, owners, and other stakeholders to accomplish their sustainability, wellness, functionality, and visual goals. We don’t just follow the trends of the industry, we trailblaze new paths to create high performance, sustainable, and award\-winning buildings.


Atelier Ten is a member company of Surbana Jurong (“SJ”), a global urban, infrastructure and managed services consulting firm based in more than 120 offices across 40 countries.


Let’s take a moment to see the overview of the role before we get into the nitty gritty.


**What is this role on a high level?**
  

We’re looking for Atelier Ten San Francisco’s newest full\-time Senior Environmental Designer. In this role, you’ll consult on and manage projects (based on your experience and capability) under the guidance of an Associate and/or Director. Beyond leading exciting projects, you’ll maintain strong client and design community relationships, participate in meetings, support or lead design charrettes, and ensure clear, effective communication across teams. You’ll also take ownership of reporting, budgeting, and time management to keep projects on track and deliver exceptional results.


**What your day\-to\-day looks like**
  

Days at Atelier Ten are filled with a large variety of project types from offices, labs to large masterplans. We promise to keep you challenged and never bored. Here are some regular tasks you may encounter:


* Independently and proactively plan and manage projects from start to finish
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through clear communication and responsive service
* Coordinate with design and contractor teams to ensure seamless project delivery
* Lead client presentations, design charrettes, and internal team meetings
* Collaborate with Atelier Ten’s technical analysis teams to integrate sustainability strategies into your projects
* Forecast project fees and resources, and manage budgets effectively
* Author and review project deliverables, including reports, memos, technical studies, and drawings
* Create compelling graphic illustrations to communicate technical concepts across our consulting practices
* Work on a diverse range of projects within the built environment, including institutional, commercial, and residential buildings, as well as large\-scale masterplans
* Partner with Atelier Ten’s integrated design groups to support services such as environmental design consulting, daylight and façade analysis, and benchmarking

**What we are looking for**
  

Hopefully you’re on board so far and excited about what your days at Atelier will look like. We do have a few items on our wish list for you to become the next great A10er. We are looking for someone who is curious, proactive, self\-motivated with an appreciation and willingness to learn on multiple projects.


And if we’re not pushing our luck with asks, you ideally will possess:


* Bachelor’s or higher degree in a field related to environmental building design, architecture, architectural engineering, and/or building science
* 5\-10 years’ professional experience in an architecture, engineering or sustainability consulting firm
* LEED, or WELL AP with specialty certification preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel and Word
* Strong ability in visual communication and sketching
* In addition, experience with software such as “R,” Grasshopper, Radiance, Revit, eQuest, EnergyPlus, IES, D3, or data visualization would be desirable
* Experience with AutoCAD, Rhino or graphics software (Adobe Illustrator and InDesign) a plus
* Effective time and budget management capability
* Strong technical and business writing skills
* Good verbal and inter\-personal ability

**What to expect from us?**


* Competitive salary
* 100% paid medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Generous paid time off
* Flexible / hybrid work schedule
* Emphasis on work life balance
* 401k matching program
* Highly engaged coworkers with a shared hunger for knowledge
* Mutual respect and support from colleagues and leadership
* Paid Life and Disability insurance
* Paid parental leave
* Paid volunteer time
* Pre\-tax commuter benefits
* Annual professional development funds
* Freedom to contribute ideas and make a personal difference that is not always possible in a large corporate environment
* Really good high\-fives

Atelier Ten US seeks to compensate staff based on a variety of factors related to the role and the candidate. These factors include (but not limited to) the responsibilities, requirements, and location of the position, as well as the candidate/s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. We also consider internal equity, market data, and growth potential. The good faith estimate of the base compensation offered for this role is between $75,000 and $85,000\. This range does not include the value of Atelier Ten’s many benefit offerings.


**How to apply**
  

Sadly, we no longer accept phone calls, award\-winning films or interpretive dances as applications. But we will take the following:


A resume and a cover letter in pdf format (which includes a little about yourself such as hobbies, last great vacation, recent reads, etc.) along with your general application.

jobs.description:
**Project Manager, Lending Technology**

**About CoreVest**


CoreVest is a leading provider of financing solutions for residential real estate investors. Our technology supports the full lending lifecycle—from origination and underwriting through pricing, closing, servicing, treasury, and capital markets.


We are looking for an experienced Project Manager who can bring structure, visibility, and momentum to complex technology initiatives across the CoreVest platform.

**The Opportunity**


As Project Manager, Lending Technology, you will lead the planning and delivery of a portfolio of business\-critical technology initiatives. You will turn strategic priorities into practical, sequenced delivery plans; align demand with internal and vendor capacity; and manage projects from initial planning through launch, adoption, and operational transition.


This is a highly collaborative role that works across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and external partners. You will help teams anticipate dependencies, resolve roadblocks, make informed tradeoffs, and maintain a clear view of scope, timing, resources, budget, and risk.


The ideal candidate combines strong project and program management fundamentals with an understanding of mortgage or real estate lending. You are comfortable moving between executive\-level portfolio discussions and the day\-to\-day details required to keep delivery teams aligned and accountable.

**What You’ll Do**

**Shape the Roadmap**

* Partner with business and technology leaders to translate annual and multiyear priorities into an integrated roadmap of programs, projects, releases, and milestones.
* Lead project intake and initiation by defining business outcomes, scope, success measures, assumptions, constraints, governance, and delivery approach.
* Sequence initiatives based on business value, regulatory commitments, architecture dependencies, operational readiness, risk, and available capacity.
* Develop scenarios and recommendations when priorities, funding, resources, or assumptions change.
* Align project plans with product roadmaps and technology architecture while maintaining clear accountability for delivery.

**Plan Capacity and Resources**

* Build rolling capacity plans using forecasted demand, team availability, delivery velocity, skill requirements, vendor commitments, and production\-support needs.
* Work with functional leaders to assign resources, address capacity or skill gaps, and manage competing priorities.
* Facilitate quarterly and release planning, including what\-if analysis and documented tradeoffs among scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risk.
* Develop and maintain project estimates, budgets, forecasts, and variance reporting.
* Manage vendor statements of work, deliverables, invoices, service commitments, and change requests.
* Coordinate resource transitions, onboarding, and knowledge transfer to support both delivery and ongoing operations.

**Lead Complex Delivery**

* Own the project lifecycle from charter and planning through execution, release, operational transition, benefits review, and closeout.
* Create and maintain integrated delivery plans, milestones, dependency maps, critical\-path analysis, RAID logs, and decision logs.
* Manage multiple concurrent and interdependent initiatives while controlling changes to scope, schedule, budget, quality, and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate work across internal teams and third parties, including projects involving lending, finance, treasury, capital markets, trading, and enterprise platforms.
* Remove impediments, clarify ownership, secure timely decisions, and escalate unresolved issues with clear options and impact analysis.
* Incorporate architecture, data, security, compliance, testing, controls, and operational readiness into delivery plans.

**Enable Agile and Hybrid Delivery**

* Apply agile, waterfall, or hybrid delivery methods based on the needs of each initiative.
* Facilitate planning sessions, standups, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and other delivery forums.
* Partner with Business Owners and Product Managers to translate requirements into actionable epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and traceable deliverables.
* Support estimation, prioritization, backlog readiness, and shared definitions of ready and done.
* Lead UAT planning, release coordination, cutover, contingency planning, training readiness, hypercare, and transition to support.

**Drive Governance and Executive Visibility**

* Establish clear governance, decision rights, meeting cadence, stage gates, and escalation paths.
* Prepare and lead steering committee and executive reviews covering milestones, spend, resources, dependencies, risks, decisions, and expected business outcomes.
* Build alignment across Business, Product, Engineering, Data, Security, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Operations, and vendor stakeholders.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation of decisions, approvals, requirements, testing, releases, and control evidence.
* Coordinate stakeholder communications, training, adoption, and organizational change activities.

**Improve How We Deliver**

**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

  

**About Digital Transformation**

Digital Transformation is a multi\-year enterprise initiative focused on standardizing business processes, creating a digital core, improving data quality, enabling AI\-driven insights, and deploying scalable technology platforms across the organization. Key initiatives include Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Quality Management Systems (QMS), and enterprise data modernization efforts.


**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

The Digital Transformation (DT) Program Manager will lead strategic transformation initiatives focused on Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and related business process modernization. This role is responsible for driving the successful delivery of complex, cross\-functional programs from planning through deployment, ensuring alignment with business objectives, digital transformation roadmaps, and enterprise architecture standards.


The Program Manager will partner with business stakeholders, IT, solution architects, vendors, and PMO leadership to design, implement, and optimize scalable business processes and technology solutions. * Product Configuration and Variant Management.
* Document and Specification Management.
* New Product Introduction (NPI) processes.
* Product Structure and Revision Management.
* Product Compliance and Quality integrations.
* Master Data Governance.
* Cross\-functional engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and quality process integration.

* PLM integration with SAP S/4HANA, MES, Quality Management Systems, and enterprise data platforms.
* Data migration, conversion, validation, and governance programs.
* Agile delivery methodologies and large\-scale global deployments.
* Semiconductor, manufacturing, or high\-tech industry experience.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, Information Systems, or related discipline.
* 10\+ years of Program or Project Management experience.
* 5\+ years leading enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex cross\-functional programs.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Expertise with Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, or similar project management tools

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
CBRE \| DIRECTLINE, a CBRE Data Center Solutions business, is a leading technology infrastructure services provider enabling mission critical data center infrastructure for the world’s technology leaders. Catering to a broad spectrum of technology and client requirements, 1200\+ skilled technicians deliver over 1000 projects annually across data center markets in the US and APAC. DL has proven success in the deployment of next\-generation infrastructure technologies across the data center lifecycle; from design \& planning, install \& build through Day 2 maintenance, technology upgrades \& retrofits, including delivering the latest wave of AI/ML platforms.

**JOB TITLE: PROJECT MANAGER**

 **About the Job:**


The Project Manager (PM) will be a lead member in our operations team and will drive the delivery of all the various network infrastructure and cabling projects within a particular site. This position will require the individual to have development, management, customer engagement, operational and overall leadership skills.


Key responsibilities will include establishing the program schedule and ensuring the established targets are met regarding schedule, cost, functionality, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.


The role will also include consulting with clients, delivering presentations, resolving project issues, recommendations for new services or enhancements, estimating, proposal writing, project costs management, directing operations on labor requirements, directing/assisting purchasing with bill of materials.


The Project Manager is responsible for the entire successful execution of a project. Their primary responsibilities are to plan, direct, coordinate, and budget activities concerned with the construction of their project. The Project Manager shall also participate and at times lead the conceptual development of a construction project and oversee its organization, estimating, scheduling, and implementation.

**What you will be doing:**

* The project manager is accountable for effective project management and delivery of their projects.
* The PM will work with the extended site team to develop the program schedule and establish key milestones for delivery of the program ensuring all financial targets and schedule targets are met in alignment to the customers' goals.
* The PM will identify and acquire all resources required by revising as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements.
* During the pre\-construction phase, continuously evaluate the materials and products being proposed for constructability and feasibility. Oversee and at times prepare the cost estimate at multiple stages. Initiate and coordinate the design efforts and the value of engineering processes.
* Schedule the project in logical steps and budget time required to meet deadlines.
* Determine labor requirements and dispatch workers to construction sites.
* Facilitate travel for technicians traveling to the project site.
* Coordinates with the superintendent.
* Inspect and review projects to monitor compliance with codes and other regulations.
* Interpret and explain plans and contract terms to staff, workers, and clients representing the owner.
* Prepare contracts and negotiate revisions, changes, and additions to contractual agreements with designers, consultants, clients, suppliers, and subcontractors.
* Obtain all necessary permits and licenses.
* Direct and supervise team members in the office and on\-site.
* Study job specifications to determine appropriate construction means and methods.
* Solicit, negotiate, select, contract, and oversee material suppliers, subcontractors who complete specific pieces of the project.
* Requisition of supplies and materials to complete construction projects.
* Prepare and submit budget estimates and progress, and cost tracking reports.
* Develop and implement quality control programs
* Take action to deal with the results of delays, bad weather, or emergencies at the construction site.
* Confer with supervisory personnel, owners, contractors, and designers to discuss and resolve matters such as work procedures, complaints, and construction problems.
* Plan, organize, and direct activities concerned with the construction and maintenance of structures, facilities, and systems.
* Investigate damage, accidents, or delays at construction sites, to ensure that proper procedures are being carried out.
* Evaluate construction means and methods to determine cost\-effectiveness of plans.
* Manage, cost/budget, and communicate the contract changes process.
* Developing and maintaining the project schedule
* Develop and maintain the project financial plan
* Prepare, maintain, and complete all aspects of the DL Way (project management playbook).
* Completes all weekly and monthly reporting and projections.
* Train and develop project team
* Responsible for timely preparation of billing to Invoice the client
* Equipment and material purchasing
* The Project Manager reviews all job cost postings for accuracy and completeness, including but not limited to, the preparation of invoices, customer collections, and periodic financial reporting to the customer and management.
* The PM will additionally manage all associated aspects of the program including the Safety \& Environment program, the quality assurance program, and material logistics.
* The Project Manager will recruit, hire, train, manage, supervise, promote, discipline and discharge, if necessary, all project related staff.
* The Project Manager will manage all human resource issues (and escalate as needed) per Company policies and procedures.
* Coordinate and partner effectively with internal and external design, construction, network, and facility partners.
* Proactively communicate program status and risks to all stakeholders
* Prepare and take corrective action to address concerns and challenges.
* The Project Manager acts as the Company liaison to the client for the program maintaining a high level of

This role requires strong technical expertise, exceptional client service skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with minimal oversight.  

The Senior Project Manager is a hands\-on delivery leader responsible for developing budgets and schedules, managing contractors and vendors, and ensuring projects meet client expectations for quality, cost, and timing. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with extensive project management experience across multiple sectors who thrives in fast\-paced environments and can maintain excellent client relationships while delivering results. **Key Responsibilities*** Identify, pursue, and secure new project opportunities, leveraging market knowledge to drive business growth.
* Independently develop complete project estimates, proposals, and schedules, and present them effectively to clients.
* Execute subcontractor procurement, including competitive bidding, negotiations, and contract execution.
* Oversee all aspects of subcontractor and vendor performance, ensuring adherence to project requirements, budgets, and schedules.
* Manage full project financials, including billing, budget tracking, change orders, and cost reconciliation.
* Create and maintain project schedules, ensuring timely completion of all milestones.
* Spend substantial time onsite to monitor quality, safety, and progress.
* Maintain proactive communication with clients, setting expectations and resolving issues.

jobs.description:

*Actual pay decision based on factors including experience, skills and training*

***$25\.00 to $28\.00 Hourly DOE***

Do you thrive in an environment where meaningful work happens every day? Do you want to make a difference in the lives of older adults?


**AlmaVia of San Rafael** is an enriching assisted living and memory care community in the heart of Marin, part of the Elder Care Alliance family. We provide exceptional, person\-centered care that enhances the quality of life for our residents.


Our **Culture of Excellence** is built on a foundation of respect, integrity, and a commitment to the well\-being of both our residents and our team members. We foster a collaborative and supportive environment where innovation and compassion drive everything we do.


**Our Resident Care Coordinator:**

* Assists in the screening and orientation of new Resident Assistants and Medication Technicians.
* Conducts audits and updates in accordance with established procedures. Ensures follow\-up actions are taken to address items identified during internal audits.
* Ensure that medications are readily available when required by facilitating timely refills.; Assists in reviewing and processing monthly cycle medication refills.
* Responsible for ordering laboratory tests as needed.
* Organizes the medication room to achieve optimal efficiency.
* As necessary, prepares and administers medication to residents as prescribed by a physician and in compliance with ECA Policies and Procedures. Reports any issues/errors, concerns, or changes.
* Oversees and publishes the schedule for Resident Assistants. May provide coverage for Resident Assistants or Medication Technicians when required.
* Facilitates the coordination and orientation process for new residents during their move\-in, onboarding, orientation, and further periods.
* Supports changes that elevate the quality of care, service, and operational efficiency.
* Exhibits a high degree of sensitivity, patience, and compassion towards residents of all needs and faculties.
* Fosters and sustains respectful interpersonal relationships with residents, their family members, and fellow staff members.
* Exhibits a comprehensive understanding of safety protocols and measures.
* Adheres to established policies and procedures and, in alignment with the resident care plan, is accountable for the prompt attention to suitable resident care.
* Promote the Mission, Vision and Values of Transforming Age in all areas of responsibility, and demonstrate commitment to Culture of Excellence and strategic goals
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**What you need to succeed:**

* High School Diploma. Completion of some college coursework or Associates’/Bachelor’s preferred.
* A minimum of six months’ experience in a long\-term care setting, home care or related field.
* Understanding of the medication program within a RCFE.
* Comprehensive understanding of Title 22, Division 6, Chapter 8\.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly in Office 365, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and email software.
* A deep understanding and passion for older adults, particularly those experiencing cognitive challenges, is essential.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities and collaborative work ethic are essential.
* Committed to delivering high\-quality and professional interactions with residents, families, peers, volunteers, and team members in a multi\-cultural environment.
* Skilled in exhibiting adaptability, making informed decisions in high\-pressure situations, and effectively prioritizing tasks and projects with flexibility and a positive attitude.
* Completion of a background check. In accordance with state/local guidelines, may require physical, fingerprint, TB testing, and/or drug screen, as well as required vaccinations (unless medical/religious exemption exists).
