jobs.title: Client Care & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Client Care \& Operations Coordinator – VetnCare**


The Client Care \& Operations Coordinator is a client\-facing customer service role at Golden State Pet Cremation, responsible for supporting families with compassionate communication while accurately handling scheduling, documentation, and day\-to\-day administrative tasks. This role focuses on high\-touch client interaction, careful attention to detail, and reliable follow\-through, working closely with field and facility teams to ensure services are coordinated smoothly and respectfully.

 **A****bout VetnCare:**


Made up of twelve veterinary hospitals situated in Northern California, VetnCare’s vision is to reimagine the local veterinary hospital so our doctors and their teams are empowered to do more advanced care, right here in our own community. Through Golden State Pet Cremation (GSPC), VetnCare supports families with compassionate, dignified end\-of\-life care, honoring the bond between pets and the people who love them.

 **The Role**

* Serve as the primary client contact, providing clear, empathetic communication and timely resolution of questions or concerns.
* Coordinate personalized memorial requests and ensure all client interactions reflect dignity and respect.
* Maintain highly accurate records for cremation services, client files, chain\-of\-custody documentation, inventory, and required documentation.
* Manage scheduling for witnessed cremations, client appointments, drop\-offs, pick\-ups, and internal operational needs.
* Oversee digital and physical filing systems and all correspondence with professionalism and consistency.
* Process payments, generate invoices, support reconciliations, and assist with vendor coordination and required documentation.
* Support daily operations by coordinating field routes, assisting crematorium technicians, and helping with onboarding logistics.
* Maintain inventory, prepare memorial items, and help maintain a clean, organized, and respectful facility environment.

 **About You**

* 3\+ years of experience in customer service, operations, logistics, or administrative support, ideally in a high\-touch or sensitive environment.
* Exceptionally organized and detail\-driven, with a track record of managing sensitive information and multi\-step processes without errors.
* Strong, compassionate communicator with experience in high\-touch, client\-facing service environments.
* Thrives in fast\-paced, multi\-step operations and takes initiative to solve problems.
* Collaborative and supportive partner to technicians, field representatives, and leadership.
* Proficient with Google Workspace/Microsoft 365\.
* Committed to delivering respectful, dignified, and high\-quality care to every family.

 **What We Offer**

* Compensation: $22\-$25 per hour
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off
* 401k
* Supportive and collaborative team environment
* Well\-equipped, clean, and modern facility
* Training and growth opportunities

  

Join a team where your work truly makes a difference. Let’s talk!

jobs.title: Quality Program Manager
jobs.description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting\-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.


**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

This role will have a high\-profile presence within the Deposition Product Group (DPG) and will drive measurable improvements in business operations through strong quality program management and sustained execution of strategic quality initiatives. The individual will lead cross\-functional quality programs, accelerate 8D cycle\-time reduction, improve supplier failure analysis effectiveness, and proactively advance DPG quality execution. This role will directly contribute to multi\-million\-dollar cost savings that will be reinvested into future growth, product development, and data\-driven business decision\-making, while reducing customer\-visible risk.


**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Lead and sustain DPG quality strategic initiatives, owning execution cadence, milestones, risk management, and measurable outcomes across assigned programs.
* Partner with DPG Quality stakeholders and the analytics team to track and manage key KPIs, quality program critical deliverables, identify trends and gaps, and deliver clear, executive\-level reporting.
* Drive alignment across Quality, Engineering, SET, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Suppliers to improve end\-to\-end DPG quality performance.
* Facilitate and lead cross\-functional teams (CFTs) to address systemic quality issues and accelerate the transition from reactive issue management to proactive risk prevention.
* Collaborate with Install \& Warranty and Inventory program managers to analyze data trends and patterns, driving targeted improvements in key performance indicators.
* Expand the impact and maturity of Cost of Quality by correlating I\&W data, ECOGS, and quality events to identify causal relationships and uncover hidden costs across the network.
* Lead and/or advise on multiple concurrent initiatives, demonstrating strong organizational, prioritization, and time\-management skills in a fast\-paced environment.
**Who we’re looking for**
-------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree with 12\+ years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, or Program Management; Master’s degree with 8\+ years of relevant experience; PhD with 3\+ years of relevant experience; or equivalent practical experience and/or PDR experience.
* Semiconductor industry experience required.
* Deep working knowledge of 8D/RCCA methodologies, failure analysis, supplier quality processes, and KPI\-driven performance management, with demonstrated ability to manage high\-complexity workloads in fast\-paced environments.
* Proven ability to define clear problem statements and objectives, develop structured analytical approaches, and execute data\-driven analyses to drive decisions and outcomes.
* Strong experience leading cross\-functional teams, demonstrating effective leadership, influence, and accountability to deliver results.
* Ability to influence and drive alignment within a fast\-paced, matrixed, cross\-functional organization.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, interpersonal, and influencing skills.
* Extensive knowledge of Lean Six Sigma methodologies, statistical analysis, and quality systems.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, including dashboard utilization and development.
* Strong executive presence, with the ability to present conclusions, insights, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.
* Ownership mindset with a bias for action to drive solutions and positive business outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal presentation skills, capable of engaging audiences at multiple organizational levels.
* Willingness and ability to benchmark and adapt best practices to continuously improve quality execution.
**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in semiconductor fabrication, semiconductor equipment operations, or closely related industries is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to improve and evolve processes and methodologies for capturing, structuring, interpreting, and using data effectively.
* Proven success applying structured problem\-solving methodologies and quality tools to resolve complex, multi\-variable problems.
* Hands\-on experience with structured problem\-solving frameworks such as PDCA, DMAIC, and 8D, including practical application of quality tools.
* Knowledge of Power BI dashboard creation and strong data analytics capabilities is a strong advantage.
**Our commitment**
------------------

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

jobs.title: Recuperative Care Community Health Worker
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**



This role is a trusted member of the Recuperative Care team, delivering health and support services for Curry Senior Center’s Recuperative Care Program. This role increases our patient’s health, health knowledge and self\-sufficiency through a range of activities such as coordinating health care appointments, coordinating food distribution for patients and tenants of the building in which our Program is housed, providing outreach, and social support. This role assists older adults in ensuring they receive health care, health education.

  


**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Actively participate as a critical member of the Recuperative Care team to increase patient well\-being, program success, and team cohesion.


* Contact patients and provide reminders, ensuring they attend their scheduled medical appointments.


* Contact patients if they miss meals to assess needs and help overcome barriers.


* Outreach to patients whom the Team has identified as needing social support.


* Support in the provision of health education to individuals or groups on topics related to health and health promotion, food insecurity, hypertension, diabetes prevention, diabetes testing, and supportive services.


* Support the coordination of the distribution of food.


* Support and lead patient social events.


* Provide information and support Case Manager(s) in providing resources necessary to improve health or address health\-related social needs. Including, but not limited to, food and nutrition, housing security, economic support, and legal services.


* Collect data and information as required by the treatment plan and Program processes.


* Participate in Program team meetings and provide feedback to improve the Program.


* Use assigned technology to complete job functions effectively.


* Maintain and document confidential information.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

  


**JOB REQUIREMENTS:**


* Associates Degree or equivalent experience.


* Community Health Worker (CHW) Certification or willingness to become certified within 1 year of hire.
* Flexibility in working hours, with the ability to work at least one weekend per month.


* Working knowledge of Electronic Health Record and/or client tracking systems.


* Trained and capable to teach basic health, sanitation, and hygiene.


* Working knowledge of basic concepts of health promotion and disease prevention.


* Experience in community work, education, health care, or related fields preferred.
* Demonstrated self\-awareness in terms of understanding one’s own race, culture, identities, biases, power, privileges, and stereotypes.


* An understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds present in the community.


* Sensitivity to populations most highly affected by homelessness and other at\-risk populations.


* Effective verbal and written communications skills with the ability to express ideas in a clear, thorough, concise manner.


* Strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills.
* Proof of negative or nonactive TB required. Curry Senior Center will provide or reimburse for the cost of a TB test after an offer of employment has been accepted by both parties. Proof of a negative TB test within 90 days will also be accepted.

  


**KNOWLEDGE, SKILL, AND ABILITIES:**


* Effective oral and written communications skills with the ability to express ideas in a clear, thorough, concise manner.


* Strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills. Solid aptitude for customer service.


* High degree of skill in grammar, spelling and punctuation.


* Ability to maintain the confidentiality of all information obtained.


* Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize workflow.


* High level of analytical problem\-solving skills.


* Excellent time management skills, including the ability to manage self\-development.


* Must be action\-oriented and have the ability to work independently and as a team player.


* Strong computer skills such as Chrome, Google suite, Apple iOS, Office suite.

  


**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/DEMANDS:**



The incumbent is in a non\-confined office\-type setting in which they are free to move about at will. The Environment is mostly clean and comfortable but may include some minor annoyances such as noise, odors, drafts, etc. Work will be performed utilizing a computer, sitting at a desk/chair or standing while speaking and interacting with clients. Position will require average finger dexterity to operate normal office equipment and systems.

  




Sitting: 35 % of the workday



Standing: 10 % of the workday



Walking: 20 % of the workday



Bending: 2\.5 % of the workday



Twisting: 2\.5 % of the workday



Lifting: 5\.0 % of the workday/Moderate, generally not over 10 pounds



Carrying: 15 % of the workday/Moderate, generally not over 10 pounds



Climbing: 10 % of the workday

  



The incumbent must be able to perform this job safely, without endangering the health or safety of themselves or others.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Hyve Company Overview**
-------------------------


Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. jobs.title: 340B Program Manager
jobs.description:
**340B Program Manager**  

Remote \| Full\-Time


**Who We Are**



NuvemRx helps community health providers deliver on their mission by simplifying the complexity of pharmacy operations, with a suite of scalable solutions that integrate software, intelligence, and expert support to illuminate savings, expand access, and elevate patient care.


**What We Are Looking For**



At NuvemRx, we hold a high bar because our work directly impacts patient care. We look for people who embody our core values:


* **Mission Always:** Every choice is a chance to serve our customers and improve healthcare
* **Be a Pioneer:** Take initiative, solve problems, and build what does not yet exist
* **Do the Right Thing the Right Way:** Lead with integrity, compliance, and thoughtful execution
* **Stronger Together:** Own your role, collaborate deeply, and elevate the team

  



We are also a fast\-growing company, which means you bring strong ownership, comfort with ambiguity, resilience, and a bias toward action.


**About the Role**



The 340B Program Manager is responsible for the oversight, administration, and ongoing compliance monitoring of the 340B Drug Pricing Program for assigned Covered Entity (CE) clients supported by NuvemRx. This position supports a variety of 340B\-eligible organizations, including Federally Qualified Health Centers, Disproportionate Share Hospitals, FQHC Look\-Alikes, and other eligible provider organizations.

  



The 340B Program Manager ensures program compliance with HRSA guidance, federal regulations, manufacturer requirements, and internal operational standards. This role oversees compliance monitoring activities, audit readiness, operational workflows, and program documentation while serving as a key liaison between clients and internal operational teams. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and capable of independently managing multiple client accounts and priorities in a fast\-paced healthcare environment.


**What You'll Do**


**Program Administration \& Compliance**


* Manage and oversee day\-to\-day administration of assigned 340B programs to ensure compliance with HRSA guidance and applicable federal and state regulations.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and compliance resource for assigned Covered Entities regarding 340B program operations, audit readiness, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct routine compliance reviews, internal audits, account monitoring, reconciliations, and operational assessments to identify potential risks or compliance concerns.
* Monitor program activity, data integrity, accumulations, replenishment activity, and operational workflows to ensure compliant program administration.
* Support and manage 340B ESP submission activities and manufacturer inquiry resolution processes as needed.
* Develop, maintain, and update policies, procedures, workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to support compliant 340B program operations.


**Audit Readiness \& Risk Management**


* Support preparation for HRSA audits, manufacturer audits, payer reviews, and internal compliance assessments, including documentation collection, audit support, and corrective action tracking.
* Maintain accurate, organized, and audit\-ready documentation related to compliance monitoring, operational activities, and client program management.
* Analyze program data and operational performance to identify opportunities for process improvement, operational efficiency, compliant savings optimization, and risk mitigation.


**Client Engagement \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Collaborate with Covered Entity leadership, pharmacy operations, finance, wholesalers, manufacturers, contract pharmacies, and third\-party administrators (TPAs) to support compliant and effective program operations.
* Participate in client meetings, compliance discussions, operational reviews, onboarding activities, and strategic program initiatives.
* Provide education and operational guidance to clients and internal stakeholders regarding 340B program requirements and best practices.


**What You Bring**


**Core Capabilities**


* Deep working knowledge of the 340B Drug Pricing Program, including HRSA guidance, compliance requirements, and program operations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client accounts and complex compliance workstreams simultaneously, with high accuracy and accountability.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret program data, identify trends, and surface actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both frontline pharmacy staff and executive\-level stakeholders.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to maintain audit\-ready documentation standards.
* Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities.


**Preferred Experience**


* Experience managing 340B programs for FQHCs, DSH hospitals, FQHC Look\-Alikes, or other covered entities.
* Familiarity with 340B third\-party administrators (TPAs), ESP submissions, and manufacturer compliance processes.
* Experience supporting HRSA audits or internal compliance assessments.
* Background in pharmacy operations, healthcare compliance, or healthcare administration.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and 340B software platforms.


**Who Thrives in This Role**


* You are a compliance\-minded professional who takes ownership of program integrity without being prompted.
* You are energized by complex regulatory environments and find purpose in keeping programs airtight for clients that serve vulnerable patient populations.
* You proactively identify risks before they become problems and bring a clear, recommended path forward.
* You build trust with clients through consistent expertise, responsiveness, and follow\-through.
* You thrive in a role that requires both deep subject matter expertise and strong cross\-functional collaboration.

jobs.title: Senior Facilities Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**MANTECH** seeks a motivated, career and customer\-oriented **Senior Facilities Operations Manager** to join our team covering multiple properties in FL, VA, and MD.

  

The **Senior Facilities Operations Manager** will leverage their strong operational and supervisor background and facilities expertise to oversee physical facility operations, and equipment setups across regional sites while proactively making recommendations for improvement to achieve organizational and client needs.

 **Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

  

* Managing daily facilities operations, maintenance activities, and related duties across multiple sites in Florida, Virginia, and Maryland.
* Ensuring the optimal utilization of the organization's facilities.
* Acting as the first point of contact for internal facilities issues, logging all maintenance, cleaning, and office/location services, and referring related issues to appropriate personnel.
* Assessing and evaluating physical space requirements of the organization and recommending plans to meet operational needs.
* Making recommendations for process, policy, and infrastructure improvements to effectively achieve organizational and client objectives.
* Accountable for team performance and results, adapting departmental plans and priorities to address resource and operational challenges.
* Overseeing setup, installation, and proper functioning of specialized operational and facility equipment through ongoing inspection and maintenance.
* Traveling up to 75% across regional locations to support property oversight, technical integration, and on\-site training initiatives.

 **Minimum Qualifications:**

  

* High School Diploma/GED with 10\+ years of progressively responsible experience in facilities operations, management, and staff hiring.
* Demonstrated expertise in facility setups and facility system maintenance across multi\-site properties.
* Experience overseeing computer and AV setups and assuring bandwidth capabilities of internet and IT infrastructure.
* Proven track record of evaluating facility operations and delivering recommendations to fulfill client and organizational objectives.
* Significant experience developing and conducting operational and/or staff training programs.
* Proven ability to work across large teams with multiple customers/clients and manage complex operational workflows.
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 75% across regional locations (FL, VA, MD).

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Facilities Management, business, hospitality, or a related field.
* Experience overseeing planning through operational stages associated with opening or updating a facility.
* Self\-starter with excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to drive operational changes across teams.
* Experience working within secure government contracting or facility environments hosting government teams.

* US citizenship is required.

 **Physical Requirements:**

  

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
* Needs to occasionally move about inside offices, mechanical spaces, and multi\-building properties, and must be able to move and inspect internal and external facilities details.
* Frequently communicates with co\-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

jobs.title: Vertical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At UVeye, we're on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world's first fully automated suite of vehicle inspection systems. At the heart of this innovation lies our advanced AI\-centric technology, representing the pinnacle of computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI within the automotive sector.

  

With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with industry giants such as Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is utilized in manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, delivery fleets, seaports, and more. Our growing global team of 250\+ employees is committed to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity, encourages teamwork, and strives for excellence.

  

The *Vertical Operations Manager* is accountable for the successful execution of delivery, installation, and lifecycle service activities within assigned verticals (Fleet, Rental, or Dealership). This role ensures sales commitments are executable by Operations and delivered to customers reliably and efficiently within defined SLAs.

 **A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:**

**﻿**

* Operational Accountability: Ensure the successful execution of delivery, installation, and lifecycle service activities within assigned verticals (Fleet, Rental, or Dealership). This includes delivering installations on time, maintaining SLA compliance, scaling delivery capacity, and achieving target costs.
* Delivery \& Support Ownership: Oversee all aspects of planning, resource allocation, safety compliance, and quality for installations, maintenance activities. Ensure installation targets are met: 2 days for Rental/Dealership installations and 4 days for Fleet installations. Ensure that maintenance (support visits) have a clear scope of work to complete on time, with a first time right approach.
* Sales\-Operations Interface: Act as the operational counterpart to the Sales and Implementation teams. This involves confirming the feasibility of sales commitments, identifying associated risks, and translating those commitments into concrete, executable operational plans.
* Field Service Leadership: Manager Field Service Engineers and Service Operations Coordinators, focusing on achieving 80% utilization, ensuring technical readiness, and developing productive capacity planning.
* Vendor Oversight: Manage installation partners and contractors. Responsibilities include continuously monitoring and evaluating vendor performance across key areas like cost, quality, and execution.
* KPI \& OKR Management: Proactively achieve critical operations metrics, including on\-time delivery, first\-time fix rates, and target cost per install, by implementing proactive corrective actions.

  

Requirements:
  

* 5\+ years of experience leading field operations, service delivery, or technical operations teams.
* Experience managing distributed Field Service Engineers (FSEs) or technical field teams.
* Experience in the automotive, fleet, rental, dealership, or a similar operational environment.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives across Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, and Operations.
* Experience with capacity planning, resource allocation, and operational forecasting.
* Strong understanding of SLAs, KPIs, and operational performance metrics.
* Experience managing high\-volume deployment, installation, or field service projects.
* Experience managing third\-party vendors, contractors, and installation partners.
* Proficiency with ERP, CRM, or Field Service Management (FSM) systems to manage operations and drive performance.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven problem\-solving skills with the ability to make operational decisions using metrics.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and escalation management skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or other project management certifications are a plus.
* Travel to on\-site locations based on business flow.

 **Benefits we offer:**

* Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision.
* Company 401k Match.
* 20 PTO days, Company paid holidays.
* Career growth as we scale across the US.

 **Compensation:**


UVeye provides salary ranges that comply with the New Jersey State Law on salary transparency in job advertisements. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, qualifications, skills, location, education, and operational needs. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentives or other forms of compensation or benefits. The annual base salary range for this position is $110,000 \- $125,000\. In addition, this position is also eligible for Bonus.

 **Physical Requirements:**


This role may involve on\-site or field\-based activities. Depending on the position, tasks may include extended periods of sitting, standing, or walking; working in and around vehicle service areas, rental facilities, dealerships, manufacturing sites, or warehouse environments; and performing occasional manual tasks such as lifting or carrying up to 40 lbs, bending, or reaching. The role may also require travel, working in varying environmental conditions, and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when appropriate. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

 **Why UVeye:**

* Pioneer Advanced Solutions: Harness cutting\-edge technologies in AI, machine learning, and computer vision to revolutionize vehicle inspections.
* Drive Global Impact: Your innovations will play a crucial role in enhancing automotive safety and reliability, impacting lives and businesses on an international scale.
* Career Growth Opportunities: Participate in a journey of rapid development, surrounded by groundbreaking advancements and strategic industry partnerships.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Solar Project Manager**

**About Valiss Home**

Valiss Home is a growing residential home\-services company focused on delivering a better customer experience across solar, battery storage, electrical, and related home\-energy services.

We are building our solar operations around clear communication, strong project management, and a high level of accountability from sale through installation and project completion.

We are looking for a Solar Project Manager who will take ownership of our customer pipeline and help make sure every project continues moving forward.

**Position Overview**

The Solar Project Manager will be responsible for managing residential solar and battery projects from the point of sale through installation, inspection, utility approval, and project completion.

This person will be the primary operational point of contact for Valiss customers and will coordinate between customers, sales representatives, installers, permitting authorities, utilities, financing partners, and internal team members.

This is not simply a scheduling position. We are looking for someone who can understand where a project is in the process, identify what is preventing it from moving forward, communicate clearly with everyone involved, and take ownership of resolving problems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the active Valiss solar and battery project pipeline from sale through project completion.
* Serve as the primary customer contact after the sale.
* Provide customers with regular and proactive project updates.
* Coordinate project handoffs from the sales team into operations.
* Review new projects to confirm required documentation and information has been received.
* Work with cities, counties, permitting authorities, and utilities to resolve project issues.
* Understand and process all residential solar permitting and utility interconnection applications.
* Coordinate with installation partners and subcontractors to keep projects on schedule.
* Identify stalled projects and take action to move them forward.
* Escalate issues when projects are at risk of delay or cancellation.
* Respond to customer questions, concerns, complaints, and project disputes.
* De\-escalate difficult customer situations and work toward practical resolutions.
* Coordinate with sales representatives when customer expectations or project details need clarification.
* Maintain accurate project notes, status updates, documentation, and next steps.
* Help develop and improve Valiss project\-management procedures as the company grows.
* Identify recurring operational problems and recommend process improvements.
* Ensure customers receive a consistent, professional Valiss experience throughout the project.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is organized, persistent, professional, and comfortable taking ownership of problems.

The right candidate should be able to manage many projects at different stages without losing track of details.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous residential solar project\-management or solar operations experience.
* Understanding of the residential solar project lifecycle.
* Experience working with solar permitting and AHJs.
* Experience with utility interconnection and PTO processes.
* Familiarity with residential battery\-storage projects is a plus.
* Experience communicating with homeowners throughout construction or installation projects.
* Experience working with sales teams, installers, subcontractors, or EPC partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to manage difficult conversations professionally.
* Ability to investigate problems and determine the next action required.
* Comfortable working with CRM, project\-management, and cloud\-based software systems.
* Ability to manage a high\-volume project pipeline.

**The Right Person for This Role**

You may be a strong fit if you naturally ask questions like:

* What is holding this project up?
* Who owns the next step?
* Has the customer been updated?
* What does the utility still need?
* Why has the permit not been approved?
* What needs to happen to get this installed?
* What can I do today to keep this project moving?

We want someone who takes ownership rather than simply documenting that a problem exists.

**Customer Experience**

Customer communication is a major part of this position.

Solar projects involve multiple parties and can take weeks or months to complete. Customers need someone who understands their project and can clearly explain what is happening.

The Solar Project Manager will be expected to communicate proactively, set realistic expectations, respond quickly when issues arise, and help resolve disagreements before they become larger problems.

**Compensation**

**Up to $20 per hour**, depending on experience.

**Growth Opportunity**

Valiss Home is in an early growth stage, and this position will play an important role in building our project\-management operation.

As project volume grows, there may be opportunities for increased responsibility within operations and project management.

Pay: $20\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Breaktime Media**


We help shoppers figure out what to buy and where to buy it. We build highly personalized, engaging content for the world's biggest CPG brands, with a focus on commerce conversion. Our work runs across retail media networks, brand sites, and loyalty ecosystems, and it reaches millions of shoppers making real decisions.


### **The role**


Breaktime is scaling, and our most ambitious work sits in promotions, loyalty hubs, retail media work and new innovation programs. We ran roughly 30 of these programs this year, they keep getting bigger, and the appetite from our brand partners is only growing. These are the programs that move the needle for our clients and for us.


We're building a dedicated program management role to match that ambition. You will own how these programs get executed: the plan, the deadlines, the dependencies, and the accountability that makes it all come together. Not the client relationship and not the creative, but the operating system across it all.


You will report to our Associate Director, Program Management, who will train you directly and work with you to build out a focused process and ramp you up on a set of programs. You will have real ownership from the start, and room to shape how this function works as we grow.


### **What you'll own**


* End to end program management for promotions, sweepstakes, loyalty hubs, omni retail media programs and custom programs that go beyond our standard content units
* Building and maintaining program timelines, from sold to live to wrap, with clear owners and dates at every step
* Task ownership across internal teams, so client services, creative, marketing and development all know what they owe and when
* Running program status meetings and keeping stakeholders honest about risk before it becomes a problem
* Partnering with client services on kickoff calls and status calls for our most complex programs
* Promotional terms and legal review deadlines, making sure nothing goes live without the right approvals in place
* Prize sourcing, ordering, and fulfillment tracking for sweepstakes and giveaways
* Facilitate and oversee Receipt Verification approval process, monitoring operations to ensure smooth program performance and reward delivery
* Documenting how we run programs, so the second one is easier than the first and the tenth is easy for anyone


### **What we're looking for**


* 3 to 5 years of project or program management experience, ideally in marketing, retail media, promotions, or agency environments
* A track record of running multiple concurrent projects with real deadlines and multiple stakeholders
* Comfort with promotional mechanics: sweepstakes, contests, rebates, loyalty offers, and the legal and operational requirements that come with them
* Strong written communication, because most of this job is making sure people know what is expected of them
* Someone who chases loose ends without being asked and follows up without being annoying
* Calm under pressure, and willing to raise a hand early when something is off track
* Experience with project management tools (ex: Atlassian, Asana or similar) and a bias toward making process simpler, not heavier


### **Nice to have**


* CPG or retailer experience, especially with Walmart, Target, Kroger, or Amazon programs
* Familiarity with loyalty platforms or shopper marketing programs
* Experience building a process from scratch rather than inheriting one
* CAPM or PMP certification

Are you an experienced senior project manager who can lead M\&A projects as well as other large, complex projects? Do you thrive in environments with many moving pieces, competing priorities, and high visibility? Do you enjoy leading cross\-functional initiatives, building trust with stakeholders, and helping teams navigate ambiguity to deliver outstanding results?



If so, we’d love to hear from you!



Grant Street Group is an innovative and rapidly growing software company that supports government agencies and financial institutions through specialized SaaS solutions focused on tax collection, electronic payments, and more. Our work is meaningful, complex, and highly collaborative — and we are looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead large, high\-impact implementation programs across multiple clients and teams. The project portfolio may include mergers and acquisitions, strategic partnerships, and integrations, as well as other major business initiatives. * Support teams through changing priorities and evolving business needs with a calm, solutions\-oriented approach

* 8\+ years of project/program management experience in M\&A, corporate development, consulting, financial services, enterprise technology, operations, or similarly complex environments

* Ability to operate independently in fast\-moving environments with evolving priorities

* Proactive problem solver who anticipates issues before they become roadblocks
* Experience recovering or stabilizing challenged projects/programs or navigating ambiguity during periods of organizational change

#### **Preferred Experience**


* Experience with due diligence coordination, integration planning, and post\-close execution
* Experience with change management, process improvement, or operational integration efforts
* Experience in SaaS, software, financial services, or other regulated industries
* Experience managing distributed or remote teams
* PMP or related project management certifications are welcome but not required
### **Why Grant Street Group?**



We reward teamwork, professional excellence, and individual responsibility. Our company is structured to support remote work, and we’ve built a culture centered on responsiveness, collaboration, trust, and delivering exceptional service to our clients.



Our strongest project managers are empowered to lead independently, solve meaningful problems, and help shape how work gets done. You’ll work alongside talented, supportive colleagues who care deeply about delivering results and helping one another succeed.

### **Company Description**


Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise\-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.


### **Team Description**


The Dropbox People Team is designing a workplace where every Dropbox employee can thrive. We take a human\-centered, HR as a Product approach—treating programs like well\-designed products shaped by employee and candidate needs, informed by data, and backed by actionable insights. Our team continuously innovates to attract, develop, and retain world\-class talent while building a culture of experimentation, craft, and community. From fostering connection in our Virtual First model to scaling HR systems and offering personalized learning tools and experiences, our work evolves to support the growth and needs of our people. We think big, act fast, and adapt with agility—grounded in outcomes, empathy, and clear communication.


### **Virtual First**


Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in\-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on\-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.


This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5\-10% of the year or 2\-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.


### **AI Fluency**


AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.
We look for four key behaviors in candidates:
* **Ownership**: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.
* **Experimentation:** You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
* **Leverage:** You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
* **Learning:** You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.

Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.  

  

Dropbox supports responsible use of AI for preparation, but misrepresentation of skills or experience is not permitted.

**Job Title**: Project Manager / Business Analyst – Healthcare Interoperability \& Claims (837/835/276/277, Medicare \& Medicaid)

**Location**: Remote (United States)  
**Employment Type**: Contract, Long\-Term (W2\)  
**Pay Rate**: $30–$60/hr (W2\), based on experience  
**Posted by**: TAP Innovations, LLC

**Overview**  
TAP Innovations is placing a senior Project Manager / Business Analyst with a client building a cloud\-based healthcare platform for skilled nursing and senior living operators. The platform covers the clinical record, healthcare data exchange, and the full medical billing cycle. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can run delivery and write the requirements. It is not a generalist PM seat. The client intends this to be a long\-term engagement.

**What You'll Do**  
\- Plan and run delivery of interoperability and claims features: scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and release readiness.  
\- Run sprint ceremonies and backlog grooming with a distributed engineering team.  
\- Coordinate clearinghouse onboarding, payer and EDI enrollment, and trading partner testing.  
\- Report status to client leadership: what is on track, what is at risk, and what decision is needed.  
\- Perform current\-state and gap analysis of billing, claims, and data\-exchange workflows in skilled nursing and senior living.  
\- Turn payer rules, companion guides, and Medicare/Medicaid policy into user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and data mappings.  
\- Define requirements across the claim lifecycle: eligibility (270/271\), authorization (278\), claim submission (837I/837P), acknowledgements (TA1, 999, 277CA), claim status (276/277\), and remittance (835\).  
\- Specify Medicare logic (Part A skilled stays, PDPM/HIPPS, consolidated billing, Part B, Medicare Advantage) and Medicaid logic (state variation, patient liability, managed Medicaid).  
\- Define coordination of benefits for dual\-eligible residents, plus denial management and A/R requirements (CARC/RARC, timely filing, aging).  
\- Gather requirements for Health Information Exchange (HIE) and apply Health Information Management (HIM) principles.  
\- Work with engineers on FHIR, HL7 v2, and C\-CDA data flows, and on the code sets that join clinical and billing data.  
\- Contribute to solution design with engineering: claim status model, denial and rework queues, remittance posting, and A/R reporting.  
\- Plan and run UAT with operational users and validate the implementation before release.

**Required Skills \& Experience**  
\- Bachelor's degree.  
\- 7\+ years of combined project management and business analysis experience, with at least 5 years in healthcare.  
\- Hands\-on medical claims processing with X12 transactions (837, 835, 276/277\) and their acknowledgements.  
\- Strong knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid financials, including how Medicare and Medicaid coordinate for dual\-eligible patients.  
\- Experience with healthcare interoperability: HIE and HIM.  
\- Proven ability to write requirements engineers can build from: user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and data mappings.  
\- Agile delivery experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.  
\- Excellent communication with executives, clinicians, billing staff, and engineers.  
\- Must reside in the US and be authorized to work in the US. Excellent written and verbal English required.

**Strong Plus**  
\- Skilled nursing, long\-term care, post\-acute, or senior living experience (MDS 3\.0, PDPM, UB\-04, Medicaid patient liability).  
\- PointClickCare, MatrixCare, or similar long\-term care EHR/billing platforms.  
\- Clearinghouse experience (Availity, Waystar, Optum/Change Healthcare), including payer enrollment and trading partner testing.  
\- Working knowledge of FHIR R4, HL7 v2, and C\-CDA.  
\- Exposure to state Medicaid MMIS, managed Medicaid, or Medicare Advantage authorization workflows.  
\- PMP, CSM/PSM, CBAP, CRCR, CPB, RHIA, or RHIT.

**Work Conditions**  
\- Remote within the US; US business hours, working with a distributed engineering team.  
\- No travel expected.  
\- Protected health information is never placed in tickets, logs, screenshots, or sample files.

TAP Innovations is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Theranostics Clinical Program Manager
jobs.description:
One Physics is expanding its Theranostics Services line to grow their Theranostics portfolio and help healthcare organizations safely and successfully launch and scale radiopharmaceutical programs including Lutetium\-177 (¹⁷⁷Lu), Radium\-223 (²²³Ra), and Fluorine\-18 (¹⁸F) based agents. We are seeking a Theranostics Clinical Program Manager with a Nuclear Medicine Technologist or Health Physicist background to help build and commercialize our Radiation Safety Theranostics services, guide current and prospective clients through theranostics readiness, and represent One Physics as a trusted technical voice in the field.


This is a hybrid clinical/commercial role: part product development, part client education and radiation safety consulting, and part market\-facing thought leadership and business development. The ideal candidate has walked in the shoes of the hospitals and imaging centers we serve as a nuclear medicine technologist, radiation safety officer, or health physicist and wants to apply that expertise to help more sites launch theranostics programs safely and efficiently.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Service \& Product Development**

* Support the development, refinement, and scaling of One Physics’ Radiation Safety Theranostics service offerings, including site\-readiness assessments, shielding and facility design input, and radiation safety program development.
* Partner with internal operational and clinical teams to translate regulatory requirements (NRC, Agreement State, and institutional Radiation Safety Committee standards) into practical, repeatable service offerings.
* Contribute subject\-matter expertise to the design of new offerings, marketing content, and training materials that support client theranostics launches.
**Client Education \& Theranostics Readiness**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to current and prospective clients, educating hospital, imaging center, and health system stakeholders on the clinical, operational, and radiation\-safety requirements for launching or scaling theranostics services.
* Conduct on\-site and virtual readiness assessments and radiation safety testing for SPECT/Nuclear Medicine and other nuclear medicine modalities (e.g., dose calibrator checks, survey meter calibration verification, shielding/leak surveys, camera/collimator setup review) to support new radiopharmaceutical program launches.
* Guide clients through the practical steps of launching radiopharmaceutical programs, drawing on direct experience with agents such as ¹⁷⁷Lu\-based therapies (e.g., Lutathera®), ²²³Ra , and ¹⁸F diagnostic agents.
* Develop and deliver training content, in\-services, and readiness checklists for nuclear medicine technologists, radiation safety officers, and hospital administration.
**Marketing, Business Development \& Thought Leadership**

* Support external marketing and product development initiatives, including attending and presenting at industry conferences (e.g., SNMMI, ASTRO, AHRA, RSNA, state radiation safety society meetings).
* Create thought leadership content — articles, webinars, case studies, and presentations — that positions One Physics as a leader in theranostics radiation safety.
* Develop and grow relationships with radiopharmaceutical manufacturers, distributors, GPOs, professional societies, and health system partners to expand the Theranostics segment at One Physics.
* Partner with sales and marketing leadership on lead generation, proposal support, and client\-facing collateral for the Theranostics service line.
* Gather and relay client and market feedback to inform service roadmap, pricing, and go\-to\-market strategy.
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Nuclear Medicine Technology, Health Physics, Radiologic Sciences, or a related clinical/scientific field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
* Background as a Certified Nuclear Medicine Technologist (CNMT/ARRT\-N) or Health Physicist, with hands\-on clinical or radiation safety experience in a nuclear medicine or radiopharmaceutical setting.
* Direct experience supporting healthcare clients through the launch of radiopharmaceutical/theranostics programs, including agents such as Lutetium\-177 (¹⁷⁷Lu), Radium\-223 (²²³Ra), and Fluorine\-18 (¹⁸F).
* Working knowledge of radiation safety testing and quality assurance for SPECT and other nuclear medicine imaging modalities (dose calibrators, survey instruments, shielding, camera QC).
* Strong presentation, writing, and client\-facing communication skills, with comfort speaking to both clinical staff and executive stakeholders.
* Ability to travel up to 50%, including overnight and multi\-day travel to client sites and conferences.
* Self\-directed and comfortable operating in a field\-based/remote role with minimal daily supervision.
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience serving as a Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) or Authorized User support for an institutional radioactive materials license.
* Prior experience in a product management, product marketing, clinical education, or client\-facing role at a radiopharmaceutical, medical device, or healthcare services company (e.g., Novartis, GE HealthCare, Cardinal Health, or similar).
* Master’s degree in Health Physics, Radiation Sciences, Healthcare Administration, MBA, or related field.
* Established relationships within the nuclear medicine, radiation safety, or theranostics community (e.g., SNMMI, HPS, AAPM).
* Experience developing marketing collateral, white papers, or conference presentations.
**What Success Looks Like in the First Year**

* Radiation Safety Theranostics service offerings are documented, standardized, and ready to scale across new client sites.
* A defined portfolio of clients has completed theranostics readiness assessments and radiation safety testing to support new program launches.
* One Physics has an established, visible presence at 2–4 major industry conferences, supported by original thought leadership conte

As an integral part of Federation’s Ensuring the Jewish Future Strategic Initiative, The Young Adult Engagement (YAE) Department is responsible for helping Jewish young adults (18\-40ish) feel a sense of connection and belonging by living a Jewish life that is joyful, meaningful, and relevant to their lives.  

NuRoots serves as Federation’s young adult community building initiative with the aim to inspires and mobilizes young adults to create meaningful connection to Jewish community across Los Angeles. **﻿About frame Security:**

**﻿**Cyber threats have evolved to AI speed—legacy security training is dead. While old\-school vendors push generic, tick\-the\-box videos, modern attacks are hyper\-targeted, deepfake\-driven, and evolving daily.


At Frame Security, we’re setting a new standard. Our AI\-native platform learns an organization’s unique DNA—its tech stack, policies, and real\-world risk—to deploy personalized, hyper\-realistic simulations in minutes.  **Who are we looking for?**


We are looking for a technical powerhouse with zero ego to join us as a Technical Account Manager (TAM).


This isn’t a standard sales TAM role—you’ll be our technical secret weapon across the entire customer journey. One day you’re partnering with Sales to crush a technical evaluation or Proof of Value (POV); the next, you’re live\-troubleshooting with a prospect or partnering with Customer Success to ensure our enterprise customers get maximum value from Frame.


You don’t need a cybersecurity background, but you *do* need rock\-solid technical fundamentals, unstoppable curiosity, and a knack for translating complex tech into plain English. If you love jumping into the deep end to solve real problems—rather than trying to be the smartest person in the room—we want to talk to you.

 **﻿Success Metrics:**

* Revenue closed
* Customer renewals \& expansion
* Achievement of company revenue and retention goals

  

Requirements:  

  

**﻿Required Skills \& Experience:**

* 2–5 years in a customer\-facing technical role (Sales/Solutions Engineer, TAM, Customer Success Engineer, or similar).
* Solid Tech Fundamentals: Hands\-on experience with enterprise IT environments (identity management, SSO/SAML, Okta, Entra ID, domain/email infrastructure).
* Grit \& Curiosity: High comfort with ambiguity, quick learning, and troubleshooting live in front of customers.
* Low Ego, High Energy: A strong bias for action, a collaborative spirit, and a calm, solutions\-oriented presence.
* Bonus Points: Experience in SaaS (cybersecurity is a nice\-to\-have, not a requirement).

 **﻿Benefits:**

* Medical, dental and vision insurance.
* Monthly connectivity reimbursement.
* Unlimited paid time off.
* 401(K) Retirement Savings Plan.
* Free daily on site lunch.
* On site covered parking.

 **﻿Why frame:**

* High Impact: Build and own processes from start to finish that directly impact our product and customers, affecting millions of people.
* Early\-Stage Advantage: Join at the ground floor of a category\-defining company. The decisions you make today will shape how the world thinks about Human Security tomorrow.

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
**Company Description:**


Raftelis helps local governments and utilities thrive by providing management consulting expertise to help transform local governments and utilities. We've provided professional consulting services to more than 700 organizations in the last year alone. We work in all areas of management consulting including finance, assessment, communications, technology, executive recruitment, and strategic planning.


We're proud to share that Raftelis has been certified as a Great Place to Work®! As one of our employees said, “at Raftelis, we maintain a great balance between hard work and allowing staff to focus on their lives outside of work. We also have a strong culture where people genuinely care about each other, and leadership is committed to doing what's best for both our employees and the firm”.


**Job Summary:**


Raftelis created Rafio, an AI agent built to make the people who serve utilities and local governments more capable, delivering intelligence they can trust and stand behind. The Customer Success Lead owns the post\-sale relationship: developing the agreement for new clients once demo and interest have been established, then owning that relationship from kickoff through confident, independent daily use and beyond. This is a hands\-on, technical customer success role. The single biggest driver of sustained usage is integration: connecting Rafio to the systems and data a customer already utilizes. You will be expected to scope, build, and troubleshoot those integrations yourself, working alongside other team members. You will also serve as the liaison between the client and the platform team, quarterbacking requests and triaging work to the right people when a need falls outside your direct support. You will report directly to the Chief Technology Officer, own the function solo at the start, and build a team as the customer base grows.


Success in this role is measured by usage that grows, customers who trust the output enough to lean on it, and a retention\-and\-expansion trajectory that becomes a revenue engine for the company.


**Primary Responsibilities:**


* Develop the client agreement once demo and interest have been established, converting engaged prospects into signed customers.
* Own onboarding end to end: take a newly signed customer from kickoff to confident, independent daily use.
* Serve as the primary liaison between the client and the platform team: quarterback requests, triage issues, and direct work to the right team members when a need falls outside your direct support.
* Deploy the platform inside the customer's real, often messy environment, rather than waiting for a clean hand\-off.
* Scope, build, and troubleshoot integrations that connect Rafio to the customer's existing systems and data, since integrations are the critical driver of usage\-based growth.
* Carry a net revenue retention and expansion target: drive growing usage across each account, identify expansion opportunities, and act on them.
* Earn and protect customer trust with a risk\-averse, accountable buyer, ensuring the output is correct and defensible because trust is the foundation of the relationship.
* Build the repeatable systems a solo function needs to scale: self\-service resources, documentation, onboarding playbooks, training, and tooling.
* Run customer enablement and education so users become proficient and self\-sufficient, not dependent on support.
* Close the loop with product: translate what you see in real deployments into clear, prioritized feedback for the engineering team.
* Build and lead the customer success team as the customer base grows.
* Other duties assigned

**Requirements:**


* Hands\-on technical ability. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to build. You can scope and wire an integration, work through an API, read documentation, and troubleshoot why a connection is not behaving, without waiting for someone else to do the technical part. On a small team, the person who owns success also helps on the platform.
* Change management understanding. You have stood up software inside someone else's environment before, where the data was messy and the process undefined, and you made it work. You are drawn to getting a customer genuinely live and using the product, not to managing a relationship from a distance.
* The ability to earn trust with a careful buyer. You have worked with risk\-averse, accountable customers, in government, education, healthcare, finance, or another high\-trust, regulated setting, and you understand that with this buyer, correctness and credibility come before everything else.
* An owner's mindset about retention and growth. You think in terms of durable, growing usage and expansion, not just keeping accounts from leaving. You have owned a number, a book of business, or a unit's outcomes before, and you are energized by being accountable for whether usage and revenue grow.
* A process and scaling mentality. Before you scale yourself with headcount, you scale yourself with systems: documentation, self\-service, repeatable playbooks, and better tooling. You have built the operational backbone that lets a small function serve a growing customer base.
* A product sensibility. You notice where a new user gets lost and you care about the first\-run experience. You can turn what you observe in real deployments into clear, useful feedback that makes the product better.
* A teacher's patience. You can take a non\-technical user from confused to confident, and you would rather build a customer who is self\-sufficient than one who depends on you. Prior experience teaching, training, or building enablement is a strong plus.
* Alignment with our mission. We serve organizations that exist to serve their communities. You share the conviction that better tools in the hands of those operators improve the everyday lives of the people they serve.

We are open to candidates from a wide range of industries and backgroun

With solutions spanning care team communication, scheduling automation, alarm management and event notifications, nurse call, patient engagement and more, we accelerate productivity, reduce costs, and improve patient outcomes, safely and securely. More than 8,000 healthcare organizations trust us to deliver enterprise\-ready solutions, making this possible with the right group of dedicated, thoughtful trailblazers. Today, private practice doctor’s offices, small and large hospice centers, and some of the largest healthcare organizations in the United States rely on TigerConnect. We’re a fun, hungry, smart, innovative group of eclectic people who are passionate about transforming the way clinical care teams work and communicate.


As a **Senior Customer Success Manager**, you will play a key role in managing post\-sales strategic client relationships at various levels with large enterprise clients. You will focus on driving strong client retention, adoption, expansion and client advocacy and contribute to business objectives such as gross and net retention. You will do this by building a trusted advisor client relationship through understanding and tracking their desired business outcomes, key metrics and continuously showing the value that they are achieving in optimizing workflows by leveraging TigerConnect’s Communication and Collaborative Platform.

  

As a strategic Customer Success Manager at TigerConnect, you will work closely with clients to understand their needs, align them with our product capabilities, and help them achieve their desired outcomes. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing strategies that drive client satisfaction, utilization, retention, and growth of our products.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Leader
jobs.description:
**About Us**  

At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since its founding in 2016, Litify has helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its leading AI\-native Platform of Action.



Over 55K legal professionals and 450\+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud\-based technology, configurable AI\-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action.



Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest\-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we're building the last legal platform our customers will ever need.


**About the Role**  

Reporting to the CRO, we're seeking a director\-level Senior Revenue Operations Leader to solve 4 things:


* Define \& Deliver a simplified, AI\-forward GTM tech stack that maximizes the capture, flow, and utilization of data across the revenue process — reducing administrative burden while improving measurable outcomes. This includes cultivating and maintaining a clean SFDC instance capable of serving as a foundation for AI initiatives.
* Elevate a business partner who operates cross\-functionally: understanding, anticipating, and solving business needs through data\-driven modeling and deliverables. Serves as the trusted advisor to the CRO.
* Create company\-wide consistency (when applicable) across the tech stack and reporting.
* Develop RevOps into a GTM partner for the CRO to develop, maintain, \& enforce a strong operating cadence that produces definable value up and down the GTM org structure.


This is not a reporting\-and\-infrastructure seat. It is a player\-coach leadership role: hands\-on in the RevOps work itself, while building and leading a team that grows with the company.



Targeted Sample Outcomes:


* A simplified, AI\-forward tech stack — CRM architecture and reporting as its foundation, with AI tooling or AI builds that are actually landed and adopted by reps, proven with usage data, not a vendor selection exercise.
* Capacity and Forecast models the business trusts and can defend — bottoms\-up, stage\-exit criteria, conditional close rates — the data\-driven modeling that makes this seat a real business partner, not just a reporting function.
* Diagnosis that turns into field\-level intervention: corrective actions that reach reps with a measurable before\-and\-after.

### **Role Responsibilities**


### **Revenue Operations \& Systems:**


* Own CRM architecture, hygiene, and stage\-gate discipline across the full sales cycle.
* Build and maintain the bottoms\-up capacity model the team's growth targets are set and defended against.
* Own revenue reporting — a single source of truth for the CRO and executive team on pipeline, bookings, and attainment.
* Run the forecast process end to end: stage\-exit criteria, conditional close rates, and a cadence where managers commit their own numbers.
* Build and lead a weekly Demand Council cadence.
* Instrument competitive\-presence tracking across the pipeline.
* Partner with the CRO \& other members of the executive team on territory design, quota setting and modeling, and compensation plan mechanics.

### **AI in the Revenue Stack:**


* Evaluate, select, and land AI tooling into the GTM stack. The bar is judgment and change management — landing something reps actually use — not necessarily building it in\-house.
* Drive adoption of what gets deployed, with usage data to show it changed behavior, not just that it shipped.
* Be personally hands\-on with the tools, not just directing a team that uses them — baseline Salesforce administrator fluency, plus firsthand experience connecting AI directly to the CRM (e.g., using Claude via MCP against Salesforce), not just vendor evaluation.
* Operate credibly on both sides of the point\-solution question, by design: able to work within and get real value out of an existing vendor stack (Domo, Terret\-style tools) and able to design and land an AI\-native replacement when that's the better call. The seat is not hired to pre\-commit to either philosophy — it's hired to have the judgment and the hands to execute whichever one a given problem actually needs.

### **Cross\-Functional Execution:**


* Drive initiatives across Sales, Marketing, and Finance without needing to own every function touched.
* Turn diagnosis into action: interventions that reach the field, with a measurable before\-and\-after.

### **Team Leadership:**


* Build and lead the RevOps team — hiring, developing, and setting priorities as it scales with the company.

### **Ideal Candidate Competencies**


* Can translate a business question into a data model — and defend that model when a sales leader disagrees with it.
* Has served as strategic advisor to a revenue leader — sat at the table for the decision, not just delivered the readout.
* Track record of putting net\-new corrective actions into a field sales organization, with a before\-and\-after.
* Has built a bottoms\-up capacity or quota model and personally defended it against a top\-down target.
* Forecast discipline — can describe how they'd know the forecast was wrong before the quarter ended.
* Has selected and landed AI tooling that changed how a field team works, backed by adoption data — vendor fluency alone is a disqualifier, not a qualification.
* Has driven cross\-organizational initiatives (Sales, Marketing, Finance) without owning every function involved.
* Can describe how the GTM tool stack's data actually connects, not just list the vendors in it.
* Comfortable operating hands\-on at Litify's scale (\~200 people) — has personally built models, not only managed analysts who did.
* Has a tinkering mindset — experience leveraging expected baseline Salesforce admin

jobs.title: Lead Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.


**So, what’s the role all about?**


After key customers have purchased and are implementing our products, the Technical Account Management (TAM) team takes ownership of the customer relationship and becomes their advocate within NiCE. The Technical Account Manager (TAM) begins to engage with the customer before they go live on the contact center platform, and works closely with the customer from that point forward to ensure their success.


Our TAMs are seasoned account management and technical resolution professionals who are at the top of their field and are unified in exceeding customer expectations, improving our processes and technology, and meeting company growth objectives. The Lead TAM is a deeply experienced and expert account management professional, responsible for resolving the most complex problems and providing excellent technical and customer service to specific key accounts. TAM will help customers overcome issues that arise, succeed in their business using our technology and services, expand their usage of our products, be a reference to prospective customers, and be a long\-term and loyal customer. The accounts assigned are generally our largest, most complex, and challenging customers.


**How will you make an impact?**


* Take ownership of the customer relationship for key CX customers and become their advocate within CX, engaging before go\-live and working closely with customers to ensure their success.
* Resolve the most complex problems and provide excellent technical and customer service to specific key accounts, including resolving technically and emotionally challenging and high\-stakes issues.
* Exemplify an effective and productive relationship with assigned accounts, holding regular discussions to review open issues, understand their contact center and business, ensure CX solutions meet their needs, and become a trusted partner and advisor.
* Ensure all technical challenges, issues, cases, and requests are handled properly and within SLA targets by partnering with Technical Support, Professional Services, Product Management, and Engineering.
* Be accountable for customer satisfaction, retention, and referenceability for all assigned accounts.

**Have you got what it takes?**

* 10 years in a Technical/Service role in software, telecommunications or in customer service, call/contact center and/or service delivery
* Demonstrated technical problem solving proficiency
* Excellent analytical and advanced troubleshooting skills with end\-users/customers
* Working technical knowledge of contact center software/design/functionality
* Implementation: broad skills in both technology \& analysis; experience in communicating at a technical and functional level while managing business rapport

**You will have an advantage if you also have:**


* TCP/IP networking knowledge and VoIP technology exposure
* Comprehensive knowledge of TCP/IP, telecom circuits from DS0 through OC\-48
* Understanding of network topology and telecommunications architecture (PBX, Carriers and VoIP)
* Understanding of basic scripting fundamentals
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP and internet fundamentals
* Extensive software, telecommunications and IP Telephony
* Experience using SIP signaling
* Competent in database and SQL concepts and scripting
* Desired personal profile: analytical, inquisitive, service \& team\-oriented, friendly demeanor, early adopter

**What’s in it for you?**


Join an ever\-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast\-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NICEr!


*This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive, and employees will also perform other reasonable related business duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and other management as required.*
  

*This organization reserves the right to revise or change job duties as the need arises. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment.*

***About NiCE***

*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000\+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3\+ billion financial transactions.*

*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30\+ countries.*

*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*
