We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.


  
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work \- credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation \- is a nightmare. We've automated that.


But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.


We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.


### **About This Role**


We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to reinvent how Headway automates and scales provider growth. As provider acquisition scales and grows more complex, we need someone who can bring go to market, engineering, and sales together around a singular vision that includes automation, AI, and world\-class tools for our sellers and marketers.


### **What You'll Own**


* Drive the roadmap around Headway's go to market systems, unifying sales, marketing/growth, and engineering around one vision
* Identify where manual effort is a real bottleneck to growth and efficiency and drive the automation that removes it
* Consolidate a fragmented tool stack into a coherent system that drives more efficient growth
* Lead innovation in our marketing stack — across revenue feeds, audiences, data enrichment, and other tools to help us acquire providers more effectively
* Partner directly with Sales leadership to innovate around how we sell and collaborate with your peers to ensure we are building a thoughtful acquisition system from top to bottom

### **You'd be a great fit if…**


* You've driven real gains in acquisition or sales\-process efficiency, with automation or tooling as one of several levers you pulled
* You've worked closely with marketers to build scalable acquisition systems (audiences, revenue feeds, attribution, conversion events, campaign management, etc)
* You can unify teams with different incentives — sales, marketing, engineering — around a single roadmap without formal authority over all of them
* You know when a process problem needs automation and when it needs a people or incentive fix instead
* You can make a technical case to engineers and a business case to sales leadership — in the same week

We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview.


Headway participates in E\-Verify.


A notice to Headway applicants: To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that Headway only accepts applications through our official careers page at https://headway.co/careers. Headway will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. All official communication will come from a @findheadway.com email address. If you are contacted by someone claiming to be from Headway via an unofficial channel, please do not share any information and report it as spam.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**


We are seeking an experienced Enablement Lead to support a GTM team that is scaling hotel partnerships globally. Working closely with a Senior Enablement Program Manager, you will develop and deliver training programs, maintain the resources field teams rely on every day, and strengthen the learning technology that supports them. This role suits someone who works well in a fast\-moving environment, takes ownership, and can make an immediate impact.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Own and develop the Salesforce resource library for field teams and their managers, including step\-by\-step process guides, quick reference guides, job aids, and short live sessions.
* Track changes in the Salesforce environment and update every affected resource before workflow changes reach the team.
* Partner with Salesforce administrators and operations colleagues to stay ahead of upcoming releases.
* Support enablement for major tooling and process launches, often with fast turnarounds and evolving requirements.
* Build role\-based resources for Market Managers, Market Associates, and Account Executives, including pitch narratives, talking points, playbooks, objection handling, certifications, and mock calls.
* Help administer the new hire onboarding program, including access requests, toolkit updates, scheduling, and follow\-through across several teams.

**Qualifications**


Required:


* 5\+ years of experience in enablement, learning and development, or sales operations, including at least 3 years enabling a sales team on Salesforce.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce: you can navigate an org, understand how objects, fields, record types, and stages relate, read a report, and explain how a proposed change will affect documentation.
* Proven ability to create just\-in\-time content such as one\-pagers, quick reference guides, short videos, and in\-tool guidance.
* Hands\-on experience with a course authoring tool such as Articulate, and with a content platform such as Highspot for publishing, organizing, managing access, and tracking usage.
* Experience running programs end to end with a high degree of independence.
* Thoughtful use of AI tools to work faster, paired with sound judgment and an interest in experimenting and scaling what works.
* Comfort with Salesforce, Slack, Google Workspace, Asana, Airtable, and Looker.
* A solutions\-oriented mindset: when you spot a problem, you bring ideas to fix it.
* Two or three work samples submitted with your application, ideally including one that explains a system change.

Preferred:


* Experience in hospitality, travel, or marketplace businesses.
* Experience with Highspot and Gong specifically.
* Instructional design training, or a learning and development background at a SaaS or marketplace company.
* Experience supporting teams across multiple regions.

**Key Details**


* Start Date: October 20, 2026

* Location: Remote (within the U.S.)

Part\-Time (20–30 hrs/week) \| Virtual \| 1–2 In\-Person Events Per Year

**People\-first. Mission\-driven. Room to grow.**

Do you believe small daily actions create extraordinary health? Do you love helping people become the version of themselves who actually follows through? Do you thrive on connection, not just checklists?

If so, keep reading.

**About Us**

We are a growing wellness practice dedicated to helping people get to the *root cause* of their health concerns—rather than just managing symptoms. Our work supports the whole person, integrating nervous system regulation, hormones, immunity, nutrition, movement, and mindset.

We’re building more than a practice—we’re building a movement in our community. And we’re looking for the *right person* to help us expand that impact.

**Our Values**

These aren’t just words—we hire and make decisions by them:

* We show up as our best selves every day
* We empower people to take back their health
* We commit to excellence and integrity in everything we do
* We believe hard work should be seen, valued, and rewarded
* We foster a positive, supportive, and growth\-oriented environment
* We embrace change and are always improving

**About the Role:**

We're looking for an exceptional Health Coach to walk alongside our clients through their 2–18 month healing journeys — helping them implement Dr. Bernardy’s personalized care plans, build sustainable habits, and stay engaged for the long haul.

This isn't a "tell them what to do" role. Our clients don't need more information — they need a coach who can help them consistently show up for themselves. You'll lead one\-on\-one sessions, run group coaching, review progress, and be one of the biggest reasons our clients stay the course and get real results.

You do not need to be a clinician — but you do need to love behavior change, believe in the process, and build real relationships.

* Are an exceptional listener who asks thoughtful, non\-judgmental questions
* Love teaching and can make complex ideas feel simple
* Have a background in nutrition and/or health coaching (Heroic Coach, FMCA, Wellcoaches, NBHWC, or similar)
* Know your way around motivational interviewing
* Can hold someone accountable *and* hold them with compassion
* Are comfortable reading basic lab trends (without interpreting them independently)
* Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged
* Celebrate progress just as much as outcomes
* Love being a part of a team
* Have a mission in life to help people create health so they can get out of suffering and live their lives \- thriving!

**Position Details:**

* Job Type: Part\-time, 20\-30h/wk
* Location: Virtual with in person team meetings based on location
* Compensation: starting 25\-30/hr (Based on experience) \+ Monthly Bonus System
* Growth: Opportunity to expand responsibilities and roles as the practice grows

We care deeply about *how* people communicate — it's core to this role.

* Your name
* Why this role caught your attention
* Why you believe you'd be a great fit for our clients and our team
* To show you're reading closely, please end your video by sharing your favorite way to start a morning

Then email the video to:

With a copy of your resume and title \>\>\>New Application: \[your name]

Benefits:

new_jobs.title: Curriculum & Education Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Applies knowledge of curriculum, program requirements, and educational activities to coordinate residency education programming and program\-wide curricular activities for the Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care. Coordinates and maintains program operations related to didactic scheduling, faculty development activities, and major educational events, including the Anesthesia Education Day (AED) series, graduation, and annual class retreats.


Maintains a program\-wide view of resident educational activities and curriculum scheduling to identify sequencing, timing, and scheduling considerations and provide guidance to program leadership. Serves as the primary scheduling contact for the PRIMER CA\-1 curriculum each summer, coordinating educational activities and schedules across participating faculty, residents, and program stakeholders.


**Department Overview**

The Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care ranks as one of the largest departments in the School of Medicine, with an annual budget of $207 million. The three largest components of the annual revenue budget are Funds Flow Revenue, the affiliation agreement with the city and county of San Francisco, and Extramural Funds, which together represent 85\.2% or $171 million. As of 2026, the department has over 200 Faculty members, 27 Staff Physicians, 200 Staff Employees, 6 Fellows, 90 Residents, 17 Non\-Faculty Academics, 13 Post Docs, and 8 Nurse Practitioners. The department also works closely with 68 Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetists (CRNAs).


In addition to the Moffitt\-Long Hospital, very active units of the department exist at the Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital (ZSFG) (inpatient and outpatient, including an active trauma service); San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center (inpatient and outpatient); Mount Zion Medical Center (outpatient, including 23 hour stays); Benioff Children's Hospital Oakland; the UCSF Orthopedic Institute; the Benioff Children's, Betty Irene Moore Women's and Bakar Cancer (NIH\-designated Cancer Center) Hospitals; and the Bayfront Medical Building (outpatient, Center for Pain Medicine) in the Mission Bay neighborhood.


The Department now has essential roles in patient care outside of the operating rooms, with active participation in Ambulatory Care, Acute and Chronic Pain, and in the Preoperative Clinic. Since 1958, the department has been at the heart of modern anesthesia’s explosive growth, and to this day continues to have an enormous impact on surgical practice and the management of pain. The department’s research, education, and clinical care earned and have maintained reputations equal to or better than that of any institution in the world. Individual members of our faculty have had a major influence on our specialty both nationally and internationally, including NIH study sections, NIH funding, and FDA and Editorial Boards. Research activities within the department are integrated with and inform clinical practice. For many years, ours has been among the top departments in the United States for NIH research funding in anesthesia.


  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
* A minimum of three (3\) years of related experience.
* Thorough knowledge of relevant policies and regulatory requirements. Solid knowledge of graduate medical education/residency program requirements. Thorough knowledge of the medical education industry.
* Thorough knowledge of curriculum development and instructional design principles; demonstrated ability to evaluate curriculum content and advise on sequencing and timing across a multi\-year training program.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing large\-scale educational events (e.g., retreats, graduation, conferences, career/job fairs), including space reservations, logistics, and vendor/speaker coordination.
* Demonstrated experience and documented excellence in oral and written communications skills; ability to work effectively and diplomatically with faculty, program leadership, and residents.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-management skills; ability to support and monitor advising/mentoring relationships and hold stakeholders accountable to program goals.
* Excellent organizational skills, analytical ability, and demonstrated attention to detail; ability to manage multiple concurrent scheduling and logistics projects and meet competing deadlines.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in related area.
* Experience with, or demonstrated ability to quickly learn, scheduling and educational program software and platforms.

Covenant House California (CHC) is a nonprofit organization that provides sanctuary and support for youth overcoming homelessness, ages 18\-24\. CHC believes that no young person deserves to be homeless; that every young person in California deserves housing, food, clothing, education, and most importantly, to be loved. CHC provides a full continuum of services to meet the physical, emotional, educational, vocational, and spiritual well\-being of young people.


CHC’s doors are open to youth and staff regardless of their race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We believe that youth and team members deserve to be in an environment that is inclusive and affirming; where everyone is treated with dignity and respect and valued and appreciated for who they are. We are also committed to being a leader in advancing anti\-racism, and to promoting opportunities for the free expression of the lived experiences of our youth and staff.

Involves managing or performing the administrative services or managing the full general operations of an academic or non\-academic organization(s). Administrative services include activities in finance and human resources and may also include IT, facilities, or student services. General management activities include long and short range strategic planning in determining the mission and directing all activities of multi\- disciplinary departments through subordinate management staff.


**Department Description:**

Alliance Health Project (AHP) is one of six clinical divisions, and several research programs that comprise Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and Trauma Center (ZSFG) Psychiatry, the second largest of 19 clinical departments at ZSFG. The mission of the AHP is to support the mental health and wellness of the lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and HIV\-affected communities in constructing healthy and meaningful lives. AHP is one of the oldest HIV organizations in the world and a leader in the field of HIV and mental health and behavioral health services focused on both HIV care and HIV prevention. AHP provides psychotherapy, substance use counseling, case management, support groups, psychiatry, sexual health services, clinical traineeship, and provider education and training. Our multi\-disciplinary staff are a client\-centered, collaborative, harm reduction\-oriented team. AHP has continued to grow as a community\-based clinic by anticipating and addressing the changing needs of our LGBTQ\+ and HIV community members for more than 40 years. Our process of continuous improvement of service to our community includes a strong focus on cultural humility and anti\-racist service provision.


AHP has an annual budget of $12 million from Federal, State and City contracts and grants, private foundations, individual donors, recharge operations, and an endowment, totaling over 40 projects; 60 full and part time staff, 5 clinical interns and over 100 volunteers per annum.


  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration or a public health field and 8\+ years of related work experience or a combination of comparable clinical education and/or experience. At least 5 years in a supervisory/lead/management role.
* Broad knowledge of the organization's processes, protocols and procedures with a focus on operations, human resources, personnel management under labor contract(s) and personnel policy.
* Ability to supervise an administrative and technical team to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* Strong knowledge of abstraction and collection of patient data, QI systems, external regulations, analytics and reporting
* Detail\-oriented, with the ability to apply analytical and critical thinking skills to quickly analyze problems, determine appropriate level of intervention, and apply effective solutions
* Demonstrated ability to effectively convey complex clinical and technical information both verbally and in writing, the ability to train and mentor direct reports, and to prepare and present various reports, documentation, analyses, and project proposals
* Working knowledge of business software and specialized applications and data management systems used in quality and performance improvement processes
* Broad knowledge of common organization\-specific and other computer application programs.
* Demonstrated management and conflict resolution skills to effectively lead and motivate others.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel, and database software, preferably Access.
* Experience with DEI principles and prior experience applying them in the work setting
* Excellent organizational, analytical and demonstrated project management abilities
* Strong working knowledge in contracts and grants
* Prior experience collaborating with DPH, DPH contracts, and relevant systems of care

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in business, healthcare administration, public health or related field.
* Prior work experience with HIV, LGBTQ\+, and BIPOC communities
* Prior UCSF, other UC campus experience or CCSF experience
* Knowledge of UCSF Government Business Contracts, Research Management Services

new_jobs.title: Senior Environmental Designer / Project Manager, San Francisco
new_jobs.description:
**Who is Atelier Ten?**
  

Thank you for asking! Kindness and curiosity are some of Atelier Ten’s core tenets.


We are a team of environmental designers and carbon strategists championing for a healthier planet by leveraging our vast, collective knowledge of sustainable spaces. We help bring beauty and efficiency to every building, because like Maybelline, not all buildings are “born with it.” We work with architects, engineers, owners, and other stakeholders to accomplish their sustainability, wellness, functionality, and visual goals. We don’t just follow the trends of the industry, we trailblaze new paths to create high performance, sustainable, and award\-winning buildings.


Atelier Ten is a member company of Surbana Jurong (“SJ”), a global urban, infrastructure and managed services consulting firm based in more than 120 offices across 40 countries.


Let’s take a moment to see the overview of the role before we get into the nitty gritty.


**What is this role on a high level?**
  

We’re looking for Atelier Ten San Francisco’s newest full\-time Senior Environmental Designer. In this role, you’ll consult on and manage projects (based on your experience and capability) under the guidance of an Associate and/or Director. Beyond leading exciting projects, you’ll maintain strong client and design community relationships, participate in meetings, support or lead design charrettes, and ensure clear, effective communication across teams. You’ll also take ownership of reporting, budgeting, and time management to keep projects on track and deliver exceptional results.


**What your day\-to\-day looks like**
  

Days at Atelier Ten are filled with a large variety of project types from offices, labs to large masterplans. We promise to keep you challenged and never bored. Here are some regular tasks you may encounter:


* Independently and proactively plan and manage projects from start to finish
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through clear communication and responsive service
* Coordinate with design and contractor teams to ensure seamless project delivery
* Lead client presentations, design charrettes, and internal team meetings
* Collaborate with Atelier Ten’s technical analysis teams to integrate sustainability strategies into your projects
* Forecast project fees and resources, and manage budgets effectively
* Author and review project deliverables, including reports, memos, technical studies, and drawings
* Create compelling graphic illustrations to communicate technical concepts across our consulting practices
* Work on a diverse range of projects within the built environment, including institutional, commercial, and residential buildings, as well as large\-scale masterplans
* Partner with Atelier Ten’s integrated design groups to support services such as environmental design consulting, daylight and façade analysis, and benchmarking

**What we are looking for**
  

Hopefully you’re on board so far and excited about what your days at Atelier will look like. We do have a few items on our wish list for you to become the next great A10er. We are looking for someone who is curious, proactive, self\-motivated with an appreciation and willingness to learn on multiple projects.


And if we’re not pushing our luck with asks, you ideally will possess:


* Bachelor’s or higher degree in a field related to environmental building design, architecture, architectural engineering, and/or building science
* 5\-10 years’ professional experience in an architecture, engineering or sustainability consulting firm
* LEED, or WELL AP with specialty certification preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel and Word
* Strong ability in visual communication and sketching
* In addition, experience with software such as “R,” Grasshopper, Radiance, Revit, eQuest, EnergyPlus, IES, D3, or data visualization would be desirable
* Experience with AutoCAD, Rhino or graphics software (Adobe Illustrator and InDesign) a plus
* Effective time and budget management capability
* Strong technical and business writing skills
* Good verbal and inter\-personal ability

**What to expect from us?**


* Competitive salary
* 100% paid medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Generous paid time off
* Flexible / hybrid work schedule
* Emphasis on work life balance
* 401k matching program
* Highly engaged coworkers with a shared hunger for knowledge
* Mutual respect and support from colleagues and leadership
* Paid Life and Disability insurance
* Paid parental leave
* Paid volunteer time
* Pre\-tax commuter benefits
* Annual professional development funds
* Freedom to contribute ideas and make a personal difference that is not always possible in a large corporate environment
* Really good high\-fives

Atelier Ten US seeks to compensate staff based on a variety of factors related to the role and the candidate. These factors include (but not limited to) the responsibilities, requirements, and location of the position, as well as the candidate/s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. We also consider internal equity, market data, and growth potential. The good faith estimate of the base compensation offered for this role is between $75,000 and $85,000\. This range does not include the value of Atelier Ten’s many benefit offerings.


**How to apply**
  

Sadly, we no longer accept phone calls, award\-winning films or interpretive dances as applications. But we will take the following:


A resume and a cover letter in pdf format (which includes a little about yourself such as hobbies, last great vacation, recent reads, etc.) along with your general application.


**Reasonable adjustments**
  

We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support—such as receiving the application form in an alternative format—please don’t hesitate to contact our recruitment team.

new_jobs.title: Recuperative Care Community Health Worker
new_jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**



This role is a trusted member of the Recuperative Care team, delivering health and support services for Curry Senior Center’s Recuperative Care Program. This role increases our patient’s health, health knowledge and self\-sufficiency through a range of activities such as coordinating health care appointments, coordinating food distribution for patients and tenants of the building in which our Program is housed, providing outreach, and social support. This role assists older adults in ensuring they receive health care, health education.

  


**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Actively participate as a critical member of the Recuperative Care team to increase patient well\-being, program success, and team cohesion.


* Contact patients and provide reminders, ensuring they attend their scheduled medical appointments.


* Contact patients if they miss meals to assess needs and help overcome barriers.


* Outreach to patients whom the Team has identified as needing social support.


* Support in the provision of health education to individuals or groups on topics related to health and health promotion, food insecurity, hypertension, diabetes prevention, diabetes testing, and supportive services.


* Support the coordination of the distribution of food.


* Support and lead patient social events.


* Provide information and support Case Manager(s) in providing resources necessary to improve health or address health\-related social needs. Including, but not limited to, food and nutrition, housing security, economic support, and legal services.


* Collect data and information as required by the treatment plan and Program processes.


* Participate in Program team meetings and provide feedback to improve the Program.


* Use assigned technology to complete job functions effectively.


* Maintain and document confidential information.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

  


**JOB REQUIREMENTS:**


* Associates Degree or equivalent experience.


* Community Health Worker (CHW) Certification or willingness to become certified within 1 year of hire.
* Flexibility in working hours, with the ability to work at least one weekend per month.


* Working knowledge of Electronic Health Record and/or client tracking systems.


* Trained and capable to teach basic health, sanitation, and hygiene.


* Working knowledge of basic concepts of health promotion and disease prevention.


* Experience in community work, education, health care, or related fields preferred.
* Demonstrated self\-awareness in terms of understanding one’s own race, culture, identities, biases, power, privileges, and stereotypes.


* An understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds present in the community.


* Sensitivity to populations most highly affected by homelessness and other at\-risk populations.


* Effective verbal and written communications skills with the ability to express ideas in a clear, thorough, concise manner.


* Strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills.
* Proof of negative or nonactive TB required. Curry Senior Center will provide or reimburse for the cost of a TB test after an offer of employment has been accepted by both parties. Proof of a negative TB test within 90 days will also be accepted.

  


**KNOWLEDGE, SKILL, AND ABILITIES:**


* Effective oral and written communications skills with the ability to express ideas in a clear, thorough, concise manner.


* Strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills. Solid aptitude for customer service.


* High degree of skill in grammar, spelling and punctuation.


* Ability to maintain the confidentiality of all information obtained.


* Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize workflow.


* High level of analytical problem\-solving skills.


* Excellent time management skills, including the ability to manage self\-development.


* Must be action\-oriented and have the ability to work independently and as a team player.


* Strong computer skills such as Chrome, Google suite, Apple iOS, Office suite.

  


**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/DEMANDS:**



The incumbent is in a non\-confined office\-type setting in which they are free to move about at will. The Environment is mostly clean and comfortable but may include some minor annoyances such as noise, odors, drafts, etc. Work will be performed utilizing a computer, sitting at a desk/chair or standing while speaking and interacting with clients. Position will require average finger dexterity to operate normal office equipment and systems.

  




Sitting: 35 % of the workday



Standing: 10 % of the workday



Walking: 20 % of the workday



Bending: 2\.5 % of the workday



Twisting: 2\.5 % of the workday



Lifting: 5\.0 % of the workday/Moderate, generally not over 10 pounds



Carrying: 15 % of the workday/Moderate, generally not over 10 pounds



Climbing: 10 % of the workday

  



The incumbent must be able to perform this job safely, without endangering the health or safety of themselves or others.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Large Enterprise
new_jobs.description:
**About the role and team**  

  

Working as a Customer Success Manager at Uber means moving beyond the polished surface of account management to solve the complex, high\-stakes operational realities our largest enterprise partners face every day. You will be the bridge between our digital platform and the physical storefronts of our most important enterprise partners, ensuring that Uber remains their preferred delivery engine through relentless analytical rigor and hands\-on problem solving.  

  

The pace is intense and the environment is frequently ambiguous, requiring a mindset that thrives when there is no established playbook. This role is for those who take extreme ownership of partner outcomes, possess the grit to navigate internal friction, and are energized by the challenge of turning complex data into real\-world marketplace reliability. If you prefer a predictable, transactional routine over the rewarding but demanding work of scaling global partnerships, this may not be the right fit for you.  

  

**What you'll do*** Build and grow long\-term partnerships by deeply understanding what matters most to our enterprise customers, moving beyond simple product support to deliver tangible business value.
* Navigate internal complexity and cross\-functional tension to advocate for product enhancements and unblock operational bottlenecks for your partners.
* Solve messy, high\-impact problems using data\-driven insights to identify patterns that impact experience at scale.
* Adapt your strategy based on shifting market dynamics and imperfect information to ensure partners see consistent ROI and platform reliability.
* Champion operational excellence by identifying and reducing "operational debt" while maintaining a high quality bar for your portfolio.
* Lead cross\-functional collaborations with operations, product, and legal teams to shape and deliver solutions that scale.

**Basic Qualifications*** 4\+ years of client\-facing experience in account management, customer success, or consulting.
* Proficiency in data analysis and using Excel to drive business judgment and decision\-making.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Proficiency in SQL to independently extract insights from large\-scale datasets.
* Experience managing stakeholders across diverse business functions and levels.
* Demonstrated systems thinking with the ability to turn unstructured, ambiguous problems into focused execution plans.
* Experience in the technology or food delivery industry managing high\-pressure projects.
* Proven ability to influence without authority and navigate complex interpersonal dynamics.

  

For Chicago, IL\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $107,000 per year \- USD $119,000 per year.  

  

For Dallas, TX\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $107,000 per year \- USD $119,000 per year.  

  

For Miami, FL\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $107,000 per year \- USD $119,000 per year.  

  

For New York City, NY\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $119,000 per year \- USD $132,000 per year.  

  

For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $119,000 per year \- USD $132,000 per year.  

  

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  

  

**Ready to Ride?**

new_jobs.description:
**340B Program Manager**  

Remote \| Full\-Time


**Who We Are**



NuvemRx helps community health providers deliver on their mission by simplifying the complexity of pharmacy operations, with a suite of scalable solutions that integrate software, intelligence, and expert support to illuminate savings, expand access, and elevate patient care.


**What We Are Looking For**



At NuvemRx, we hold a high bar because our work directly impacts patient care. We look for people who embody our core values:


* **Mission Always:** Every choice is a chance to serve our customers and improve healthcare
* **Be a Pioneer:** Take initiative, solve problems, and build what does not yet exist
* **Do the Right Thing the Right Way:** Lead with integrity, compliance, and thoughtful execution
* **Stronger Together:** Own your role, collaborate deeply, and elevate the team

  



We are also a fast\-growing company, which means you bring strong ownership, comfort with ambiguity, resilience, and a bias toward action.


**About the Role**



The 340B Program Manager is responsible for the oversight, administration, and ongoing compliance monitoring of the 340B Drug Pricing Program for assigned Covered Entity (CE) clients supported by NuvemRx. This position supports a variety of 340B\-eligible organizations, including Federally Qualified Health Centers, Disproportionate Share Hospitals, FQHC Look\-Alikes, and other eligible provider organizations.

  



The 340B Program Manager ensures program compliance with HRSA guidance, federal regulations, manufacturer requirements, and internal operational standards. This role oversees compliance monitoring activities, audit readiness, operational workflows, and program documentation while serving as a key liaison between clients and internal operational teams. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and capable of independently managing multiple client accounts and priorities in a fast\-paced healthcare environment.


**What You'll Do**


**Program Administration \& Compliance**


* Manage and oversee day\-to\-day administration of assigned 340B programs to ensure compliance with HRSA guidance and applicable federal and state regulations.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and compliance resource for assigned Covered Entities regarding 340B program operations, audit readiness, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct routine compliance reviews, internal audits, account monitoring, reconciliations, and operational assessments to identify potential risks or compliance concerns.
* Monitor program activity, data integrity, accumulations, replenishment activity, and operational workflows to ensure compliant program administration.
* Support and manage 340B ESP submission activities and manufacturer inquiry resolution processes as needed.
* Develop, maintain, and update policies, procedures, workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to support compliant 340B program operations.


**Audit Readiness \& Risk Management**


* Support preparation for HRSA audits, manufacturer audits, payer reviews, and internal compliance assessments, including documentation collection, audit support, and corrective action tracking.
* Maintain accurate, organized, and audit\-ready documentation related to compliance monitoring, operational activities, and client program management.
* Analyze program data and operational performance to identify opportunities for process improvement, operational efficiency, compliant savings optimization, and risk mitigation.


**Client Engagement \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Collaborate with Covered Entity leadership, pharmacy operations, finance, wholesalers, manufacturers, contract pharmacies, and third\-party administrators (TPAs) to support compliant and effective program operations.
* Participate in client meetings, compliance discussions, operational reviews, onboarding activities, and strategic program initiatives.
* Provide education and operational guidance to clients and internal stakeholders regarding 340B program requirements and best practices.


**What You Bring**


**Core Capabilities**


* Deep working knowledge of the 340B Drug Pricing Program, including HRSA guidance, compliance requirements, and program operations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client accounts and complex compliance workstreams simultaneously, with high accuracy and accountability.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret program data, identify trends, and surface actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both frontline pharmacy staff and executive\-level stakeholders.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to maintain audit\-ready documentation standards.
* Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities.


**Preferred Experience**


* Experience managing 340B programs for FQHCs, DSH hospitals, FQHC Look\-Alikes, or other covered entities.
* Familiarity with 340B third\-party administrators (TPAs), ESP submissions, and manufacturer compliance processes.
* Experience supporting HRSA audits or internal compliance assessments.
* Background in pharmacy operations, healthcare compliance, or healthcare administration.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and 340B software platforms.


**Who Thrives in This Role**


* You are a compliance\-minded professional who takes ownership of program integrity without being prompted.
* You are energized by complex regulatory environments and find purpose in keeping programs airtight for clients that serve vulnerable patient populations.
* You proactively identify risks before they become problems and bring a clear, recommended path forward.
* You build trust with clients through consistent expertise, responsiveness, and follow\-through.
* You thrive in a role that requires both deep subject matter expertise and strong cross\-functional collaboration.

Job Title: Quality Assurance/Project Controller
Job Category: Information Technology
Time Type: Full time
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret
Employee Type: Regular
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%
Type of Travel: Continental US
\* \* \*
**The Opportunity:**
--------------------

  

CACI is seeking an experienced **Quality Assurance / Software Test Lead** to support the **Navy Medicine Online (NMO)** development team. In this role, you will provide comprehensive software quality assurance and testing oversight, reviewing development work and validating application readiness prior to production release.

  

  

You will develop, implement, and maintain formal quality assurance processes, testing standards, and documentation while monitoring compliance throughout the software development lifecycle. You will also support the **Risk Management Framework (RMF)** as directed by the **Defense Health Agency (DHA)** and participate in **Annual Security Reviews (ASR), Authority to Operate (ATO), and Independent Verification and Validation (IV\&V)** activities.

  

  

This position serves as the **final quality gate prior to software release** , providing documented **GO, GO\-WITH\-CONDITIONS, or NO\-GO** recommendations based on testing results, identified risks, defects, security considerations, and overall release readiness.


You will leverage **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** and modern test automation technologies to improve testing efficiency, strengthen software quality, accelerate defect identification, and support continuous improvement across the NMO development environment.

  

  

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

  

* Design, develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, test scripts, and automated test suites for web applications, web services/APIs, ETL processes, data warehouses, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications.
* Manage and support project pipelines within **Application Lifecycle Management (ALM)** environments, including testing activities, defect management, quality controls, and release readiness.
* Identify, analyze, document, prioritize, and track software defects, performance bottlenecks, integration issues, and other quality concerns using test results, application logs, monitoring tools, and supporting technical data.
* Communicate test strategies, execution status, quality metrics, defects, risks, and release\-readiness findings to government Project Managers and other technical and program stakeholders.
* Serve as the final quality gate for software releases, providing documented **GO, GO\-WITH\-CONDITIONS, or NO\-GO** recommendations with clear technical rationale, risks, and required corrective actions.
* Provide technical guidance, testing standards, and QA best practices to strengthen organizational quality assurance capabilities and promote continuous process improvement.
* Leverage AI\-assisted development and testing capabilities to design, maintain, and optimize scalable test automation frameworks using technologies such as **Puppeteer, Selenium, Java, NUnit, JUnit, REST Assured** , or comparable automation frameworks.
* Design and execute automated testing for **RESTful web services and APIs** , including authentication and authorization, request/response validation, contract testing, error handling, performance testing, and system integration testing.
* Perform cross\-browser, accessibility, database, backend, and integration testing to validate application functionality, performance, usability, and data integrity.
* Develop and execute **SQL queries** to validate database transactions, application behavior, data accuracy, and end\-to\-end system functionality.
* Support **RMF, ASR, ATO, and IV\&V** activities by providing required testing evidence, quality documentation, technical findings, and remediation support.

new_jobs.description:
**Solar Project Manager**

**About Valiss Home**

Valiss Home is a growing residential home\-services company focused on delivering a better customer experience across solar, battery storage, electrical, and related home\-energy services.

We are building our solar operations around clear communication, strong project management, and a high level of accountability from sale through installation and project completion.

We are looking for a Solar Project Manager who will take ownership of our customer pipeline and help make sure every project continues moving forward.

**Position Overview**

The Solar Project Manager will be responsible for managing residential solar and battery projects from the point of sale through installation, inspection, utility approval, and project completion.

This person will be the primary operational point of contact for Valiss customers and will coordinate between customers, sales representatives, installers, permitting authorities, utilities, financing partners, and internal team members.

This is not simply a scheduling position. We are looking for someone who can understand where a project is in the process, identify what is preventing it from moving forward, communicate clearly with everyone involved, and take ownership of resolving problems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the active Valiss solar and battery project pipeline from sale through project completion.
* Serve as the primary customer contact after the sale.
* Provide customers with regular and proactive project updates.
* Coordinate project handoffs from the sales team into operations.
* Review new projects to confirm required documentation and information has been received.
* Work with cities, counties, permitting authorities, and utilities to resolve project issues.
* Understand and process all residential solar permitting and utility interconnection applications.
* Coordinate with installation partners and subcontractors to keep projects on schedule.
* Identify stalled projects and take action to move them forward.
* Escalate issues when projects are at risk of delay or cancellation.
* Respond to customer questions, concerns, complaints, and project disputes.
* De\-escalate difficult customer situations and work toward practical resolutions.
* Coordinate with sales representatives when customer expectations or project details need clarification.
* Maintain accurate project notes, status updates, documentation, and next steps.
* Help develop and improve Valiss project\-management procedures as the company grows.
* Identify recurring operational problems and recommend process improvements.
* Ensure customers receive a consistent, professional Valiss experience throughout the project.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is organized, persistent, professional, and comfortable taking ownership of problems.

The right candidate should be able to manage many projects at different stages without losing track of details.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous residential solar project\-management or solar operations experience.
* Understanding of the residential solar project lifecycle.
* Experience working with solar permitting and AHJs.
* Experience with utility interconnection and PTO processes.
* Familiarity with residential battery\-storage projects is a plus.
* Experience communicating with homeowners throughout construction or installation projects.
* Experience working with sales teams, installers, subcontractors, or EPC partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to manage difficult conversations professionally.
* Ability to investigate problems and determine the next action required.
* Comfortable working with CRM, project\-management, and cloud\-based software systems.
* Ability to manage a high\-volume project pipeline.

**The Right Person for This Role**

You may be a strong fit if you naturally ask questions like:

* What is holding this project up?
* Who owns the next step?
* Has the customer been updated?
* What does the utility still need?
* Why has the permit not been approved?
* What needs to happen to get this installed?
* What can I do today to keep this project moving?

We want someone who takes ownership rather than simply documenting that a problem exists.

**Customer Experience**

Customer communication is a major part of this position.

Solar projects involve multiple parties and can take weeks or months to complete. Customers need someone who understands their project and can clearly explain what is happening.

The Solar Project Manager will be expected to communicate proactively, set realistic expectations, respond quickly when issues arise, and help resolve disagreements before they become larger problems.

**Compensation**

**Up to $20 per hour**, depending on experience.

**Growth Opportunity**

Valiss Home is in an early growth stage, and this position will play an important role in building our project\-management operation.

As project volume grows, there may be opportunities for increased responsibility within operations and project management.

Pay: $20\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™
  
  

Support Quality. Strengthen Processes. Drive Continuous Improvement.
  
  

ASRC Federal is seeking a Quality Systems Specialist to support the administration, maintenance, and continual improvement of our Quality Management System (QMS) and Process Improvement Program. This is a hands\-on opportunity for a quality professional who enjoys working across the organization to ensure processes are effective, compliant, and continuously improving.
  
  

In this role, you will help maintain ISO 9001 certification and CMMI Maturity Level 3 process maturity by supporting internal audits, monitoring process compliance, maintaining quality documentation, tracking corrective actions, and analyzing quality metrics. You will work closely with Program Managers and teams across Procurement, Contracts, Business Development, Information Security, and other functional areas to ensure processes align with organizational standards, customer requirements, and applicable federal contract requirements.
  
  

Reporting to the Sr. Director of Quality and Environmental, Health \& Safety, you’ll play an important role in strengthening our quality culture, identifying opportunities for improvement, and helping ensure our processes are ready to support both current operations and future business needs.
  
  

**Work location:** Remote
  
  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Internal Audit Support:
* Schedule, coordinate, and perform internal quality audits
* Support internal process and project audits
* Document audit observations, findings, and opportunities for improvement
* Track corrective and preventive actions through closure
* Verify completion of corrective actions and maintain audit records
* Assist with coordination of external ISO surveillance audits, recertification audits, and CMMI appraisals
* Process Compliance Monitoring:
* Monitor compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and contract\-specific higher\-level quality requirements
* Conduct periodic reviews of project\-level documentation for process adherence
* Identify process deviations and notify responsible managers
* Assist in performing root cause analysis for quality issues
* Recommend improvements to organizational processes based on audit findings and lessons learned
* Proposal and Contract Support:
* Assist proposal teams by providing current quality management documentation and process descriptions
* Support reviews of quality\-related contract requirements for consistency with organizational policies and processes
* Support program/project implementation of customer\-specific quality requirements following contract award
* Maintain reusable quality artifacts to assist with proposal development


**Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s degree with 5\+ years of relevant work experience
* Proficiency with ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System requirements and certification schemes, and current working knowledge of ISO 9001:2026 QMS requirements
* Proficiency with CMMI Version 3\.0 process maturity model and appraisal method
* Working knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and agency\-specific supplemental (i.e., Defense, General Services, NASA) requirements applicable to federal contractors
* Ability to conduct process reviews and identify compliance issues
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience supporting Department of War, NASA, and Civilian federal agency contracts
* Experience supporting and guiding external registration audits and CMMI appraisals
* Experience planning, scheduling, performing, and leading internal quality audits


**Preferred Certifications:**  

* ISO 9001 or higher\-level quality management system (i.e., AS9100\) Lead Auditor or Lead Internal Auditor
* Certified CMMI Practitioner, or higher


We invest in the lives of our employees, both in and out of the workplace, by providing competitive pay and benefits packages. Benefits offered may include health care, dental, vision, life insurance; 401(k); education assistance; paid time off including PTO, holidays, and any other paid leave required by law. The salary offered will depend on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity, business needs, and other factors permitted by law. Posted pay ranges are a general guideline only and are not a guarantee of compensation or salary.
  
  

EEO Statement
  
ASRC Federal and its Subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, gender, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, religion, marital status, ancestry, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor prohibited by applicable law.

new_jobs.title: Operations Coordinator, Collections, Bilingual (Spanish-English)
new_jobs.description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting\-edge technology, we're enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?


We're hiring Bilingual (Spanish\-English) Operations Coordinators for our Collections \& Recoveries team to have direct, honest conversations with customers every day about getting their accounts back on track, fairly and respectfully.


**The impact you'll make:**



A customer's fallen behind on a credit card payment. They already know what they owe. What they don't know is whether taking our call means getting further behind, or getting somewhere. They need someone on the other end of the line who will tell them plainly what's owed and what their options are, listen to what's going on, and help them land on a plan that works for their life.



As an Operations Coordinator on the Collections \& Recoveries team, you're that voice. Your job on every call is to be straightforward, be kind, and get to a plan that helps the cardholder move forward.


**As Operations Coordinator, you will:**


* Speak with customers who've fallen behind on payment, understand their circumstances, and ask directly for what's owed, in full or through a workable payment plan.
* Work with customers through pushback and objections, staying patient and persistent as you build toward a plan that works for them.
* Follow established scripts, tools, and account guidelines to keep every conversation consistent, professional, and compliant.
* Read a conversation quickly and adjust your approach, always keeping the ask in view.
* Keep accurate, timely records of every call and outcome in our systems.
* Meet daily and weekly targets for collections, call quality, and productivity.
* Take coaching and feedback fast, and apply it on your very next call.
* Flag anything unusual (a complex account, a dispute, a technical issue) to your manager right away for guidance.
* Stay actively engaged with your team throughout your shift in Collaboration Room AI, our virtual, video\-based team space where you and your teammates stay visible and connected in real time, the same way you would in a physical office.


**You'll thrive in this role if:**


* You can be firm and fair in the same conversation.
* You're comfortable asking directly for payment and staying patient and persistent when a customer pushes back.
* You stay calm and in control even when conversations get tense.
* You seek out feedback and put it into practice.
* You like structure and consistency, and you follow procedures accurately.
* You enjoy being part of a connected, engaged remote team.


**Minimum qualifications:**


* 1\+ year of experience in a phone\-based, customer\-facing role (collections, customer service, sales, or similar).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and Spanish.
* Ability to consistently meet performance expectations in a metrics\-driven environment.
* Ability to work a remote schedule while maintaining an active presence in Collaboration Room AI throughout your shift, camera on outside of breaks and lunch.
* Fast, reliable internet (minimum 80 Mbps download / 8 Mbps upload) and a private, quiet workspace.


**Preferred qualifications:**


* Direct experience in consumer debt resolution.
* High school diploma or GED.
* Familiarity with contact center technology (e.g., dialers, case management tools).
* Comfortable working with call center metrics.
* Bilingual professional fluency in English and Spanish.
* Proficiency with our key business technology platforms: Mac OS, Google Workspace, Tableau, and Slack.
* Working knowledge of relevant financial regulatory requirements (e.g. FDCPA, TCPA, FCRA, BSA, SCRA, MLA, UDAAP).


**Work Location \& Virtual Team Culture:**


* This is a remote position for residents of AR, AZ, FL, KS, GA, MO, NC, SC, TN, TX, UT, and VA.
* This role operates within a highly supportive virtual team environment. We rely on Collaboration Room AI, Slack and Google Meet for daily communication, coaching, and team huddles to ensure consistent support and performance alignment.


**Schedule:**


* Depending on business need at time of hire, you may be offered one or more of the following shift options:
* + Shift A: M\-F, 8:30 AM \- 5:00 PM Eastern Time
	+ Shift B: M\-F, 10:30 AM \- 7:00 PM Eastern Time
	+ Shift C: M\-F, 12:30 PM \- 9:00 PM Eastern Time

**Compensation:**



Starting hourly base pay range: $18\.11 \- $20\.16



Your starting base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience.



Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote\-first work environment.



This position offers a clear path for internal progression. Based on the achievement of defined performance goals, you would have the opportunity for promotion within your first year of employment. After promotion, you would be eligible for incentive pay based on performance, in addition to your base hourly rate.

  

**About Mission Lane:**



Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose\-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.



It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn't have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less\-than\-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn't do.

As a field\-based position, you’ll be on\-site, visiting dealerships daily—connecting with partners, driving growth, and making an impact where it matters most. The role typically follows a six\-day work week, offering hands\-on engagement and the chance to truly own your territory. Bring your passion for auto finance, your drive to succeed, and your commitment to delivering exceptional results.

\*\*\*Residence within or near the assigned geographic territory is required.\*\*\*

* **Prospecting and Business Development:** Identify and engage new dealership partners to expand our network, drive growth, and strengthen market presence in the automotive finance sector.
* **Dealer Support and Relationship Management:** Provide exceptional service and consultative support to dealer partners through on\-site visits to ensure satisfaction, loyalty, and long\-term success.

new_jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Leader
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**  

At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since its founding in 2016, Litify has helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its leading AI\-native Platform of Action.



Over 55K legal professionals and 450\+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud\-based technology, configurable AI\-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action.



Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest\-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we're building the last legal platform our customers will ever need.


**About the Role**  

Reporting to the CRO, we're seeking a director\-level Senior Revenue Operations Leader to solve 4 things:


* Define \& Deliver a simplified, AI\-forward GTM tech stack that maximizes the capture, flow, and utilization of data across the revenue process — reducing administrative burden while improving measurable outcomes. This includes cultivating and maintaining a clean SFDC instance capable of serving as a foundation for AI initiatives.
* Elevate a business partner who operates cross\-functionally: understanding, anticipating, and solving business needs through data\-driven modeling and deliverables. Serves as the trusted advisor to the CRO.
* Create company\-wide consistency (when applicable) across the tech stack and reporting.
* Develop RevOps into a GTM partner for the CRO to develop, maintain, \& enforce a strong operating cadence that produces definable value up and down the GTM org structure.


This is not a reporting\-and\-infrastructure seat. It is a player\-coach leadership role: hands\-on in the RevOps work itself, while building and leading a team that grows with the company.



Targeted Sample Outcomes:


* A simplified, AI\-forward tech stack — CRM architecture and reporting as its foundation, with AI tooling or AI builds that are actually landed and adopted by reps, proven with usage data, not a vendor selection exercise.
* Capacity and Forecast models the business trusts and can defend — bottoms\-up, stage\-exit criteria, conditional close rates — the data\-driven modeling that makes this seat a real business partner, not just a reporting function.
* Diagnosis that turns into field\-level intervention: corrective actions that reach reps with a measurable before\-and\-after.

### **Role Responsibilities**


### **Revenue Operations \& Systems:**


* Own CRM architecture, hygiene, and stage\-gate discipline across the full sales cycle.
* Build and maintain the bottoms\-up capacity model the team's growth targets are set and defended against.
* Own revenue reporting — a single source of truth for the CRO and executive team on pipeline, bookings, and attainment.
* Run the forecast process end to end: stage\-exit criteria, conditional close rates, and a cadence where managers commit their own numbers.
* Build and lead a weekly Demand Council cadence.
* Instrument competitive\-presence tracking across the pipeline.
* Partner with the CRO \& other members of the executive team on territory design, quota setting and modeling, and compensation plan mechanics.

### **AI in the Revenue Stack:**


* Evaluate, select, and land AI tooling into the GTM stack. The bar is judgment and change management — landing something reps actually use — not necessarily building it in\-house.
* Drive adoption of what gets deployed, with usage data to show it changed behavior, not just that it shipped.
* Be personally hands\-on with the tools, not just directing a team that uses them — baseline Salesforce administrator fluency, plus firsthand experience connecting AI directly to the CRM (e.g., using Claude via MCP against Salesforce), not just vendor evaluation.
* Operate credibly on both sides of the point\-solution question, by design: able to work within and get real value out of an existing vendor stack (Domo, Terret\-style tools) and able to design and land an AI\-native replacement when that's the better call. The seat is not hired to pre\-commit to either philosophy — it's hired to have the judgment and the hands to execute whichever one a given problem actually needs.

### **Cross\-Functional Execution:**


* Drive initiatives across Sales, Marketing, and Finance without needing to own every function touched.
* Turn diagnosis into action: interventions that reach the field, with a measurable before\-and\-after.

### **Team Leadership:**


* Build and lead the RevOps team — hiring, developing, and setting priorities as it scales with the company.

### **Ideal Candidate Competencies**


* Can translate a business question into a data model — and defend that model when a sales leader disagrees with it.
* Has served as strategic advisor to a revenue leader — sat at the table for the decision, not just delivered the readout.
* Track record of putting net\-new corrective actions into a field sales organization, with a before\-and\-after.
* Has built a bottoms\-up capacity or quota model and personally defended it against a top\-down target.
* Forecast discipline — can describe how they'd know the forecast was wrong before the quarter ended.
* Has selected and landed AI tooling that changed how a field team works, backed by adoption data — vendor fluency alone is a disqualifier, not a qualification.
* Has driven cross\-organizational initiatives (Sales, Marketing, Finance) without owning every function involved.
* Can describe how the GTM tool stack's data actually connects, not just list the vendors in it.
* Comfortable operating hands\-on at Litify's scale (\~200 people) — has personally built models, not only managed analysts who did.
* Has a tinkering mindset — experience leveraging expected baseline Salesforce admin

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

**About the Role**


This role will join the FIS GTM and Sales Enablement organization as a senior member of the Field Enablement team. Reporting to the Director, Field Enablement, this role owns bringing GTM and product launch content to life for the field through sales playbooks, sales training, video content, e\-learning and Power Learning modules delivered through our sales enablement platform (Seismic).

  

The successful candidate will be technology and AI savvy, using AI routinely across different platforms, such as Copilot, Claude, Jasper and Seismic, including AI\-enabled role\-play, to strengthen seller knowledge and performance, accelerate content creation, improve workflows and drive automation. This is a great opportunity for an experienced, collaborative and commercially minded enablement professional who enjoys processing complex product and solution content and turning it into clear, engaging learning for sales. The role suits someone who works with a high degree of autonomy across multiple platforms, influences stakeholders at all levels in a global matrix organization and constructively challenges existing processes where a simpler, smarter or more scalable approach is possible.  



  

\*\*Must be located in EST\*\*

* Lead the design of AI\-enabled role\-play scenarios and practice content to support seller readiness ahead of client conversations.
* Translate GTM and product launch briefs into field\-ready enablement programs, partnering closely with Product Marketing and GTM stakeholders to shape launch readiness plans.

* Own internal field communications, such as newsletters and launch updates, that keep the field informed of new content and programs.
* Drive the day\-to\-day operating rhythm of the Field Enablement function, including status reporting to leadership, prioritization and coordination across priority initiatives.
* Act as a trusted voice of the field, gathering seller and presales feedback to continuously improve content and delivery.

new_jobs.title: Health Coach – Wellness Business (Remote)
new_jobs.description:
**Health Coach**

Part\-Time (20–30 hrs/week) \| Virtual \| 1–2 In\-Person Events Per Year

**People\-first. Mission\-driven. Room to grow.**

Do you believe small daily actions create extraordinary health? Do you love helping people become the version of themselves who actually follows through? Do you thrive on connection, not just checklists?

If so, keep reading.

**About Us**

We are a growing wellness practice dedicated to helping people get to the *root cause* of their health concerns—rather than just managing symptoms. Our work supports the whole person, integrating nervous system regulation, hormones, immunity, nutrition, movement, and mindset.

We’re building more than a practice—we’re building a movement in our community. And we’re looking for the *right person* to help us expand that impact.

**Our Values**

These aren’t just words—we hire and make decisions by them:

* We show up as our best selves every day
* We empower people to take back their health
* We commit to excellence and integrity in everything we do
* We believe hard work should be seen, valued, and rewarded
* We foster a positive, supportive, and growth\-oriented environment
* We embrace change and are always improving

**About the Role:**

We're looking for an exceptional Health Coach to walk alongside our clients through their 2–18 month healing journeys — helping them implement Dr. Bernardy’s personalized care plans, build sustainable habits, and stay engaged for the long haul.

This isn't a "tell them what to do" role. Our clients don't need more information — they need a coach who can help them consistently show up for themselves. You'll lead one\-on\-one sessions, run group coaching, review progress, and be one of the biggest reasons our clients stay the course and get real results.

You do not need to be a clinician — but you do need to love behavior change, believe in the process, and build real relationships.

**You're Likely a Great Fit If You:**

* Are an exceptional listener who asks thoughtful, non\-judgmental questions
* Love teaching and can make complex ideas feel simple
* Have a background in nutrition and/or health coaching (Heroic Coach, FMCA, Wellcoaches, NBHWC, or similar)
* Know your way around motivational interviewing
* Can hold someone accountable *and* hold them with compassion
* Are comfortable reading basic lab trends (without interpreting them independently)
* Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged
* Celebrate progress just as much as outcomes
* Love being a part of a team
* Have a mission in life to help people create health so they can get out of suffering and live their lives \- thriving!

**Position Details:**

* Job Type: Part\-time, 20\-30h/wk
* Location: Virtual with in person team meetings based on location
* Compensation: starting 25\-30/hr (Based on experience) \+ Monthly Bonus System
* Growth: Opportunity to expand responsibilities and roles as the practice grows

**How to Apply (Important)**

We care deeply about *how* people communicate — it's core to this role.

To be considered, please read this posting fully, then record a Loom video telling us:

* Your name
* Why this role caught your attention
* Why you believe you'd be a great fit for our clients and our team
* To show you're reading closely, please end your video by sharing your favorite way to start a morning

Then email the video to:

With a copy of your resume and title \>\>\>New Application: \[your name]

We're a small team and care deeply about who joins us. Please only apply if this role truly resonates with you and you are looking for a position you can grow with and be a part of long term.

Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote
